title: Support Engineer
description:
The ClientWorks Product Delivery team is seeking a Support Engineer 2 to support Oracle Health (Millennium)products through system\software configuration for the Oracle Health Multi-Tenant customer base. In this role, you will serve as a primary point of contact for ClientWorks Product Managers, responding to system\software configuration change requests for current and future state product needs, collaborating with internal teams to address customer configuration needs and maintain accurate documentation. You will also contribute to AI-enabled operational efficiency by identifying repetitive activities, using approved automation tools and AI assistance, and supporting improvements that reduce manual configuration effort and help the team scale.

  

**Key responsibilities:**

* Serve as a primary contact to support ClientWorks Product Managers, triaging and configuring system\software requests.
* Independently configure, validate, and document approved system\software configuration changes for assigned Oracle Health (Millennium) products.
* Collaborate with internal teams to investigate and resolve configuration-related requests across our supported Multi-Tenant customer and internal Sales domains.
* Support domain access activities for internal stakeholders.
* Maintain complete Jira records, configuration documentation, and reusable guides for common requests.
* Use SQL and advanced Microsoft Excel capabilities to support data analysis, configuration validation, and operational reporting.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual configuration activities and contribute to workflow improvements using approved tooling and AI assistance.
* Communicate request status, dependencies, and issues clearly; prioritize competing requests and escalate when necessary.
* Participate in Agile team activities, knowledge sharing, and continuous process improvement.

**Required qualifications:**

* In depth **configuration experience using Oracle Health (Millennium) products.**
* At least three years of relevant experience in service management and change management.
* Familiarity with AI tools and practical experience applying them responsibly to improve productivity and streamline routine tasks.
* Strong SQL skills and advanced Microsoft Excel proficiency.
* Experience using Jira to track, prioritize, and document requests.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently on assigned requests, manage competing priorities, and collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders.
* Ability to identify repetitive work and contribute to automation and process improvement.
* Availability to work the required shift of **3:30 PM IST to 12:30 AM IST the following day** .

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Oracle Health (Millennium) Pharmacy product configuration experience.
* Experience with automation scripting or tools used to streamline configuration and support activities.
* Familiarity with Agile methodologies and responsible use of AI-assisted productivity tools.

title: Consulting Engineer
description:
The role focuses on customer engagement and experience by working closely with customers to create value, drive adoption, and support renewals, while proactively collaborating with cross-functional teams such as Customer Success, Sales, Support, and product and engineering to ensure a unified customer experience throughout the lifecycle. Responsibilities include designing, deploying, optimizing, migrating, and troubleshooting Cisco products and solutions using technical expertise, AI and automation, and strategic guidance, ensuring optimal performance and customer satisfaction. The position serves as a focal point for proactive problem resolution, delivering timely support across Cisco and third-party technologies, and develops technical content and guidance to support customer engagements, drive solution adoption, and enable customer self-sufficiency in partnership with Customer Success. Additionally, the role creates customer-facing documentation aligned with CX standards, leverages AI and automation to enhance delivery efficiency and innovation and increases personal productivity by focusing on high-impact work. The position also involves developing vertical market expertise to translate customer business needs into technical solutions, building knowledge of vendor and competitor products to ensure interoperability and optimization, and contributing to knowledge sharing and the development of digital intellectual capital, including documentation templates and automation artifacts to improve Cisco's delivery methodology and processes.

* Grows expertise across Cisco products, deepening expertise in one architecture domain, and understands vendor capabilities that work alongside competitor products
* Impact within team and other teams in assigned theater
* Engages directly with customers; builds trust and rapport

* Creates and reviews project deliverables aligned to CX standards; contributes to new implementation techniques and methodologies
* Creates customer-facing documentation for complex solutions, ensuring technical accuracy; collaborates with internal teams to deliver and maintain content
* Provides insights on product and software vulnerabilities, advising customers on product issues and builds complex lab set-ups to resolve diverse
* Demonstrates expertise across a range of technologies and delivery methods (both Cisco and other vendors as needed for migration and integration)
* Leverages working knowledge of software programmability, automation, orchestration, virtualization, Agile and DevOps to optimize project outcomes
* Explains complex technical concepts to diverse audiences and transfers knowledge to customers to ensure effective use of products and solutions
* Contributes to knowledge management, technical documentation, and continuous improvement of Cisco products and solutions
* Proactively analyzes and scans the competitive landscape to identify potential opportunities for innovation and AI transformation

equivalent relevant work experience

title: IT Engineer,Software,Advanced
description:
Overview:

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.

Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.

Responsibilities:

Keysight is seeking an Advanced IT Software Engineer to join the IT / Engineering Tools Center of Excellence, which supports engineering applications for R&D. You will lead the design and development of several open-source enterprise engineering applications used globally, including the CDS / Site Sync applications that process and distribute purchased part and CAD information to engineers worldwide. You will partner closely with IT service providers across the company and use AI-assisted development practices to improve code quality, documentation, and delivery speed.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead systems design and development for open-source enterprise engineering applications used by R&D teams worldwide.
* Understand and document requirements, design solutions, write code, perform unit testing, and resolve technical issues.
* Provide deep-level support for production applications, using strong diagnostics and root cause analysis.
* Become the subject matter expert for these applications, applying usability and development best practices.
* Partner with business, design, and development team members, and with IT service providers, to deliver high-quality IT services and customer satisfaction.
* Develop and maintain database components that support part and CAD data processing and distribution.
* Use approved AI tools to accelerate coding, code review, unit test creation, troubleshooting, and documentation. Validate all AI-generated output before use.
* Apply AI-assisted techniques to understand, document, and modernize legacy Perl and shell code.
* Identify and pilot AI use cases that improve engineering productivity, such as part and CAD data validation, anomaly detection, log analysis, and support triage.
* Lead code walkthroughs and share secure, responsible AI-assisted development practices with the team.
* Create and execute work plans, adjusting as requirements change.

Qualifications:

*Required*

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years of IT experience designing and developing software solutions.
* 3+ years of Perl development experience.
* 4+ years of Unix/Linux shell script development experience.
* 2+ years of Unix/Linux administration experience (Red Hat preferred).
* Web application design and development (HTML, XML, CSS, JavaScript, web services).
* Working knowledge of Windows, UNIX, and Red Hat Linux, and of Tomcat, Apache, and process, CPU, and connection diagnostics.
* Working knowledge of network technologies (NFS, CIFS, SMB, FTP, rsync).
* Strong diagnostics and root cause analysis skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication in a globally diverse environment.
* Self-directed and a team player, with the ability to explain code in a walkthrough.
* Curiosity and sound judgment in using AI tools, with awareness of data privacy, intellectual property, security, and accuracy considerations.

*Preferred*

* Database development experience.
* Hands-on experience using generative AI or LLM-based assistants for software development, such as code generation, refactoring, test creation, and documentation.
* Experience applying AI to legacy code understanding or modernization.
* Experience integrating AI-enabled workflows or APIs into engineering applications.
* Interest in or exposure to big data technologies.
* Experience with engineering data such as CAD or part and component information.

title: Associate - Analytics Data Engineer
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Join a team focused on analytics enablement—designing analytics-ready data models and a trusted semantic layer that standardizes business metrics. You will partner with stakeholders to translate requirements into well-modeled datasets in Databricks and Snowflake, using SQL as your primary language and Python when needed. You will define consistent metrics and semantic conventions that enable scalable self-service reporting. You will help create a data ecosystem where consumers trust and reuse what has been built.

Job summary

As an **Analytics Solutions Associate** within **Analytics Engineering**, you will build analytics-ready data models and a trusted semantic layer that standardizes business metrics. You will partner with stakeholders to translate requirements into governed, reusable datasets and semantic definitions. You will own the structure and usability of downstream analytics by defining grains, dimensions, facts, conformed entities, and metric logic so teams can move faster with confidence. You will collaborate with upstream engineering partners to ensure source-to-model alignment and ensure data quality and documentation meet a high bar. Success looks like consistent key performance indicator definitions across dashboards, clear semantic conventions, and performant, well-documented models.

Job responsibilities

* **Lead** development of analytics data models (dimensional and/or domain-oriented) optimized for reporting, business intelligence, and self-service consumption.
* **Design** and maintain a semantic layer (standardized metrics, dimensions, entities, and business definitions) to ensure consistency across dashboards and analyses.
* **Translate** stakeholder requirements into clear modeling deliverables (entities, grains, metric definitions, acceptance criteria).
* **Build** transformations primarily in SQL, leveraging Python when needed for complex logic, automation, or validation.
* **Implement** and champion data quality controls (tests, reconciliations, anomaly checks) tied to business-critical metrics.
* **Optimize** model performance in Snowflake and/or Databricks (efficient joins, partitioning and clustering strategies where applicable, cost/performance trade-offs).
* **Collaborate** with upstream teams on source system understanding (including semi-structured data and non-relational sources) and ensure analytics models reflect correct business meaning.
* **Establish** modeling standards: naming conventions, documentation, lineage, metric governance, and change management for semantic definitions.
* **Support** enablement by documenting curated datasets, creating user guidance, and helping consumers adopt the semantic layer correctly.

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

**Minimum education and experience required:** Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Operations Research or related field of study plus 3 years of experience in the job offered or as Analytics Engineer or related occupation. The employer will alternatively accept a Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Operations Research or related field of study plus 5 years of experience in the job offered or as Analytics Engineer or related occupation.

* Advanced SQL skills (complex joins, performance tuning, incremental logic).
* Strong understanding of data modeling (facts and dimensions, grains, conformed dimensions, slowly changing dimensions, metric design).
* Demonstrated experience building or operating a semantic layer or metrics framework (tool-agnostic; ability to standardize key performance indicator logic and definitions).
* Comfort working with semi-structured data (JSON) and non-relational sources and modeling them for analytics.
* Exposure to data governance concepts (role-based access control, data classification, lineage, audit requirements).
* Working experience with Snowflake and/or Databricks in an analytics context.
* Practical Python skills for data workflows (validation, automation, notebooks and scripts).
* Ability to partner with stakeholders, clarify ambiguous requirements, and drive to measurable outcomes.
* Strong documentation habits and attention to data correctness.

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

* Experience with testing and documentation.
* Familiarity with business intelligence tooling and semantic consumption patterns (for example, Tableau, Sigma, or Looker concepts).
* Knowledge of orchestration and observability (for example, Airflow, Dagster, or Azure Data Factory; logging and alerting; service level agreement mindset).

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**
  
  
J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

title: Data Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer to design, develop, and optimize scalable data pipelines and cloud-native data solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). The role involves building robust ETL/ELT frameworks, implementing Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, enabling CI/CD practices, and delivering high-quality data products. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in DBT, GCP services, data modeling, and modern data architecture

  

Your role As an AI Data Engineer at Kyndryl, you’ll be the architect behind the high-performance data infrastructure that powers our autonomous systems. We aren't just moving tables; we’re building the real-time pipelines that allow agentic AI to reason over the world’s most complex enterprise environments. Join Kyndryl and gain the trust, autonomy and teamwork to help define what comes next. What you will do Orchestrate Intelligence •Architect for RAG: You’ll design and scale the pipelines for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), transforming massive volumes of unstructured IT logs and documentation into optimized Vector Embeddings. •Scale vector infrastructure: You will be responsible for the health and performance of our vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus, or Weaviate), ensuring sub-second retrieval speeds for agentic reasoning loops. Master Data Transformation •Engineer semantic layers: Move beyond simple ETL to build knowledge graphs and semantic layers that provide agents with the necessary context to navigate complex infrastructure puzzles. •Automate data excellence: Using a keen eye for detail, you’ll build automated data guardrails to detect noise, bias, or PII (Personally Identifiable Information) before it reaches the model, ensuring our AI remains safe and impactful. Own the Backbone •Solve meaningful challenges: Serve as the bridge between raw, messy data sources and deep technical AI work, identifying and resolving quality issues at the source. •Progress to production: With a well-defined methodology and software engineering prowess, you will build, deploy, and maintain the CI/CD pipelines for our data infrastructure, ensuring that our context window remains fresh and reliable.

  

Your Future at Kyndryl
  
As an Application Consultant at Kyndryl you will join the Kyndryl Consultant Profession, working with other Kyndryl Consultants, Architects, Project Managers, and cross-functional Technical Subject Matter Experts – presenting unlimited opportunities with unmatched support through our investment in your learning, training, and career growth.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

**Required Skills and Experience:**

  

* Overall 6+ Years of experience into IT.

* Expertise in data mining, data storage and Extract-Transform-Load (ETL) processes

* Experience in data pipelines development and tooling, e.g., Glue, Databricks, Synapse, or Dataproc

* Experience with both relational and NoSQL databases, PostgreSQL, DB2, MongoDB

* Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and critical thinking skills

* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, while maintaining a high level of attention to detail

* Ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical colleagues, to derive and translate technical requirements from business needs Preferred skills and experience

* Experience working as a Data Engineer and/or in cloud modernization

•Experience in Data Modelling, to create conceptual model of how data is connected and how it will be used in business processes •Professional certification, e.g. Open Certified Technical Specialist with Data Engineering Specialization

* Cloud platform certification, e.g. AWS Certified Data Analytics – Specialty, Elastic Certified Engineer, Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer, or Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate

* Understanding of social coding and Integrated Development Environments, e.g. GitHub and Visual Studio

* Degree in a scientific discipline, such as Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Information Technology

**Preferred Skills and Experience:**

DBT, GCP, BigQuery, Data Engineer, Terraform, CI/CD, DevOps, SQL, Spark, Apache Beam, Hive, Cloud Run, Iceberg, Hudi, Avro, Parquet, Data Mesh, Data Modeling, ETL, ELT, Data Pipeline, Google Cloud.

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Service Reliability Engineer- Apple Data Platforms
description:

This Position reports to:

Senior Operation Manager for D&A

**Mission of the Role**

Do you enjoy turning real business challenges into working AI solutions? Would you like to do it at a global company that is changing its industry with new technology? ABB is looking for a **hands-on AI/ML Engineer** to join our **Information Systems (IS)**.

This is a **specialist role where you build the solutions yourself**. It is not a coordination or management role. You will work with the business to understand its needs and then find the best answer. That could be a predictive model, an LLM or SLM, an AI agent, a GenAI application, analytics, automation or a conventional solution. You will take that solution from idea to production and keep it running well in operations.

If you have experience with **Azure AI/ML, Snowflake, GenAI and MLOps**, and you want to own solutions from start to finish across both Dev and Ops, this opportunity is for you!

**Work model:** Hybrid #LI-Hybrid

**Responsibilities**

**Business understanding and solution design**

* Work with business stakeholders and Data Analysts to clarify needs, requirements, expected outcomes, success measures, data and context requirements, risks and ownership.
* Decide which approach fits each business problem best: AI/ML, GenAI, analytics, automation or a conventional solution. This includes choosing the right model type (ML, LLM, SLM), the right agent design and the right technology.
* Design scalable solutions that follow enterprise architecture, security and governance standards, with guidance from the Advanced Analytics Architect and platform architects.

**Build and deploy**

* Develop, validate and deploy production-ready AI/ML solutions using Python, SQL, Azure Machine Learning, Microsoft Foundry and other approved technologies.
* Build ML and GenAI applications, including predictive models, RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt/context engineering, AI agents, APIs, orchestration, retrieval and enterprise data integrations.
* Build and integrate LLM-based solutions and conversational agents using Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI and, where appropriate, Copilot Studio and Power Platform. Support Copilot and other AI platforms, such as Anthropic models.
* Use enterprise data from **SAP and Salesforce** to build predictive models, GenAI applications and AI agents that deliver measurable business value.
* Build secure, reliable data ingestion and processing from **Snowflake** and other enterprise sources, with attention to data quality, lineage, access control and cost efficiency.
* Apply Snowflake AI/ML capabilities, including **Snowpark ML, Cortex AI, Cortex Search and AI Functions**.
* Develop reusable components and automated pipelines for data preparation, feature engineering, training, inference, evaluation, testing, deployment and retraining, using CI/CD and version control.

**Evaluate, operate and improve (DevOps / MLOps / AIOps)**

* Evaluate model accuracy, explainability, grounding, agent behaviour, safety, business value, performance, reliability and cost.
* Set up and run MLOps/AIOps practices: monitoring, drift detection, **cost monitoring, root-cause analysis**, retraining and continuous improvement. You own both development and operations.
* Contribute to production readiness, operational handover, incident and problem analysis, monitoring design and reliable day-to-day operations.
* Apply Responsible AI, information security, privacy, compliance, identity and access management, secrets management and other ABB requirements within your solution scope.

**Ownership and collaboration**

* Own your deliverables end to end. Estimate effort, manage priorities, report progress and risks, and work independently within the agreed architecture and platform guardrails.
* Work closely with Data Analysts, Data Scientists, Snowflake Developers, Data Engineers, Power BI/Fabric Developers, platform specialists and domain experts.
* Document solution logic, assumptions, limitations, evaluation results and operational requirements. Contribute reusable assets, engineering practices, knowledge sharing and mentoring.

**Requirements**

**Education and experience**

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4–6 years of hands-on experience in Data Science, AI/ML Engineering, analytics engineering or related roles, including taking AI/ML solutions to production.
* Experience delivering AI/ML solutions end to end: business requirements, data preparation, development, validation, deployment and monitoring.

**Technical skills**

* Practical Python and SQL skills for data preparation, model development, API integration, testing and implementation.
* Hands-on experience with **Azure Machine Learning and Microsoft Foundry**: pipelines, compute, environments, model deployment, endpoints, agents and evaluation.
* Strong understanding of GenAI patterns: LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt/context engineering, agent design and evaluation.
* Working knowledge of ML and statistics: supervised and unsupervised learning, model validation, regression, time series and hypothesis testing.
* Experience with ML frameworks such as Scikit-learn and, where relevant, XGBoost, PyTorch or TensorFlow.
* Experience with automated pipelines and CI/CD, using version control and testing practices, preferably in Azure DevOps or GitHub.
* Hands-on experience with **Snowflake AI/ML tools** (Snowpark ML, Cortex AI, Cortex Analyst, Cortex Search, AI Functions) and Snowflake connectors.
* Experience analysing, modelling and integrating **SAP and Salesforce** data. This means understanding source data structures, business entities, relationships and transformation requirements.

**Operations and governance**

* Understanding of how AI/ML solutions run in production: monitoring, reliability, performance, cost management, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement.
* Working knowledge of enterprise architecture, cloud security, privacy, compliance, data governance and Responsible AI principles.

**Communication and language**

* Ability to turn business needs into technical solutions, explain options and trade-offs, and communicate clearly with technical and business stakeholders.
* Fluent spoken and written English (minimum C1).

**Nice to Have / Differentiators**

* Experience with LLM frameworks such as the Azure OpenAI SDK, LangChain, Semantic Kernel or equivalent.
* Experience with other AI platforms and models (e.g., Anthropic, SLMs).
* Microsoft certifications: Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102), Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate (AI-103), Azure Data Scientist Associate (DP-100) or Machine Learning Operations Engineer Associate (AI-300).
* Snowflake certifications, such as SnowPro Core or relevant GenAI certifications.
* Experience using Azure DevOps for work planning, execution and reporting.
* Experience with Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Streamlit or other data visualisation tools.
* Knowledge of Azure infrastructure for AI/ML workloads: networking, VNets/private endpoints, Entra ID, RBAC, managed identities, Key Vault, storage, containers, Azure Monitor and Application Insights.
* Infrastructure as Code experience (Bicep or Terraform).
* Experience mentoring colleagues or contributing to shared engineering standards and reusable assets.

**What We Offer**

* The chance to be part of a global company working on high-impact industrial projects.
* A collaborative environment with continuous learning, advanced technologies and a strong development culture.
* Room to grow on a solid technical career path at ABB.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.

title: Mainframe Application Support Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

  

As a Mainframe Application Support Engineer at Kyndryl, you’ll solve complex problems and identify potential future issues across the spectrum of platforms and services. You’ll be at the forefront of new technology and modernization, working with some of our biggest clients – which means some of the biggest in the world.

  

There’s never a typical day as a Mainframe Application Support Engineer at Kyndryl, because no two projects are alike. You’ll be managing systems data for clients and providing day-to-day solutions and security compliance. You’ll oversee a queue of assignments and work directly with technicians, prioritizing tickets to deliver the best solutions to our clients.

  

**What You Will DO**

  

* Provide L2/L3 production support for mainframe applications built on Natural and Adabas, ensuring high availability and operational stability.
* Monitor application performance, troubleshoot incidents, and resolve production issues within agreed SLA timelines.
* Perform root cause analysis of application failures and implement preventive solutions to minimize recurring issues.
* Support batch processing, online transactions, job scheduling, and production release activities across environments.
* Collaborate with business users, development teams, and infrastructure teams to drive timely issue resolution and service improvements.
Maintain operational documentation, support change and release management processes, and ensure compliance with security, audit, and business continuity requirements.  

  

One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You’ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. Does the work get challenging at times? Yes! But you’ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career.

  

**Your future at Kyndryl**

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Technical and Professional Expertise**

  

* 4+ Years of experience in Mainframe Application Support with a focus on Natural and Adabas technologies.
* Proven experience working in IBM z/OS environments with solid knowledge of JCL, TSO/ISPF, SDSF, and mainframe utilities.
* Good understanding of CICS, VSAM, batch processing, job scheduling, and production support operations.
* Experience supporting mission-critical applications in a 24x7 production environment, including incident, problem, and change management processes.
* Hands-on experience with scheduling and monitoring tools such as CA-7, Control-M, OPC/TWS, or equivalent.
* Strong troubleshooting, root cause analysis, performance tuning, and data correction skills for Natural/Adabas applications.
* Experience with ServiceNow or other ITSM tools for incident and service request management.
Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to work effectively across global teams.  

  

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**

  

* Familiarity with application deployment, release management, and environment migration activities.
* Knowledge of Adabas performance monitoring, database support fundamentals, and application optimization techniques.
* Exposure to ITIL-based service management practices and continuous service improvement initiatives.
* Experience participating in on-call production support, major incident management, and disaster recovery exercises.
Understanding of automation, operational efficiency, and proactive monitoring practices within mainframe environments.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
**Corporate:**  
Light & Wonder’s corporate team is comprised of incredible talent that works across the enterprise, defying boundaries to provide essential services in an extraordinary manner to ensure the success of the organization and the well-being of employees.

**Position Summary**

Serves as the technical gatekeeper for AI tools built by non-developers and aids in the builds and deployment of AI solutions across the enterprise, specifically the CFO organization. Ensures that when a business user builds something with AI, it's safe, accurate, and operates within the established governance guidelines.

**Key Responsibilities**

Review AI solutions built by non-developers against best-practice engineering standards and the team's governance framework before they go into production.

Champion reusable architecture patterns and templates so solutions can be redeployed across all BUs rather than rebuilt each time.

Assess citizen-developer builds for data lineage, model accuracy thresholds, human-in-the-loop safeguards, and audit trail compliance, then flag and lead to remediate gaps.

Aid to implement automated output validation, drift detection, and exception escalation for solutions post-launch.

Track token/API usage and cost at the solution and BU level; support monthly usage reporting to CFO leadership.

Design, build, and deploy AI/LLM-integrated solutions for FP&A, accounting, audit, and reporting workflows; maintain all code in Git with version control and peer review.

Partner with the FP&A AI Sr. Analyst on requirements, the AI Governance lead on control design, and enterprise IT/architecture on alignment.

**Qualifications**

**Required Skills** **: Technical**

Python (or equivalent) for automation and data pipeline work.

Cloud platform experience (Azure/AWS preferred).

Hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI).

Git-based version control, structured code review, and change management practices.

SQL and ETL/data pipeline experience.

Working familiarity with low-code/RPA platforms (Power Platform, UiPath, Copilot Studio), with enough depth to competently review, not necessarily build in them.

Understanding of AI governance concepts: model validation, drift detection, data lineage, audit trails.

**Required Skills** **: Domain & Communication**

Able to explain technical risk in plain language to non-technical finance staff whose builds are under review.

Working knowledge of finance processes sufficient to judge business context and materiality of a given AI build.

Comfortable working across business units with varying technical maturity.

Finance/accounting background or FP&A exposure.

Experience standing up a citizen-developer governance program or AI Center of Excellence.

SOX/internal controls familiarity.

As a prerequisite to employment with L&W (to the extent* *permitted* *by law), you shall be asked to consent to L&W conducting a due diligence/background investigation on you.*

title: threat detection engineer
description:
**what is CRED?**

CRED is an exclusive community for India’s most trustworthy and CREDitworthy individuals, where the members are rewarded for good financial behavior. CRED was born out of a need to bring back the focus on a long lost virtue, one of trust, the idea being to create a community centered around this virtue. a community that constantly strives to become more virtuous in this regard till they finally scale their behavior to create a utopia where being trustworthy is the norm and not the exception. to build a community like this requires a community of its own; a community special in its own way, working towards making this vision come true

here’s a thought experiment: what do you get when you put a group of incredibly passionate and driven people and entrust them with the complete freedom to chase down their goals in a completely uninhibited manner? answer: you get something close to what we have at CRED; CRED just has it better

### **what you will do ?**

* work across a diverse information security domain, with a strong focus on threat detection, response, and security telemetry across infrastructure, cloud, and data
* identify and investigate security threats (internal and external), partner with stakeholders on remediation, and design preventive controls for recurring or systemic issues
* design, build, and continuously improve high-fidelity detection use cases across cloud, endpoint, identity, and network telemetry
* formulate new detection ideas based on adversary research, emerging attack techniques, industry incidents, and threat intelligence
* lead and participate in incident response, performing root-cause analysis and driving preventive improvements post-incident
* develop and enhance the CRED’s detection, monitoring and response capabilities
* automate incident response workflows using playbooks and orchestration to reduce manual effort
* build in-house security analytics solutions using open source tools (log parsing, event correlation and threat detection)research/conduct threat hunting operations using known adversary tactics, techniques and procedures to detect advanced threats
* assist with creating security awareness and maintaining prudent security engineering culture within an organization
* enable compliance in teams and help them achieve some of the industry’s best practices (e.g. PCI DSS, ISO 27001)

### **you should apply if you have:**

* 2 to 6 years of experience in information security with a strong focus on threat detection and response
* hands-on experience detecting and responding to threats across cloud (aws preferred), endpoint (windows/linux/macOS), and network telemetry
* exposure to EDR, IDS/IPS, and SIEM / centralized logging platforms (splunk, ELK, sentinel, or similar), including building high-fidelity detection pipelines
* proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language (python, go, or bash)
* solid understanding of MITRE ATT&CK, cyber kill chain, and diamond model
* ability to design and tune detection rules using MITRE ATT&CK and threat intelligence with a focus on signal quality
* experience with threat hunting, automation and enrichment, regex creation, and false-positive reduction
* experience handling the complete incident response lifecycle, from detection through remediation and reporting
* strong data-driven mindset with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* ability to act as a go-to person, communicating clearly with engineering, product, and business teams
* proactive approach to staying current with security news, breach reports, tools, and attacker research
* strong learning agility and passion for exploring diverse security domains, demonstrated via github, blogs, research, or talks
* exposure to the AI-driven threat landscape, digital forensics, or malware analysis is a strong plus

**how is life at CRED?**

working at CRED would instantly make you realize one thing: you are working with the best talent around you. not just in the role you occupy, but everywhere you go. talk to someone around you; most likely you will be talking to a singer, standup comic, artist, writer, an athlete, maybe a magician. at CRED people always have talent up their sleeves. with the right company, even conversations can be rejuvenating. at CRED, we guarantee a good company.

hard truths: pushing oneself comes with the role. and we realize pushing oneself is hard work. which is why CRED is in the continuous process of building an environment that helps the team rejuvenate oneself: included but not limited to a stacked, in-house pantry, with lunch and dinner provided for all the team members, paid sick leaves and a comprehensive health insurance.

to make things smoother and to make sure you spend time and energy only on the most important things, CRED strives to make every process transparent: there are no work timings because we do not believe in archaic methods of calculating productivity, your work should speak for you. there are no job designations because you will be expected to hold down roles that cannot be described in one word.

since trust is a major virtue in the community we have built, we make it a point to highlight it in the community behind CRED: all our employees get their salaries before their joining date. a show of trust that speaks volumes because of the skin in the game.

there are many more such eccentricities that make CRED what it is but that’s for one to discover. if you feel at home reading this, get in touch.

title: Software Development Engineer
description:
**About the team**
------------------

At Zillow our mission is to give people the power to unlock life’s next chapter. The Elevate Engineering team plays an important part in connecting advertisers with the hundreds of millions of customers that visit Zillow websites each month. From scaling ad experiences that fuse on-site and social media together, to building marketplaces where consumers can shop for products and services, we have a big responsibility in how advertisers and customers engage with each other. We love it!
  
  
We are a dynamic team that makes a significant impact with its contributions. Members of this team have the opportunity to:
  
  
Work on products and initiatives that directly generate revenue
  
Collaborate with multiple teams across our consumer brands and corporate operations
  
Have their ideas heard and often implemented as new products, features or solutions
  
Use and evolve best-in-breed technology
  
Showcase leadership (and be appreciated for it!)
  
Develop a career path in new and relevant ways
  
Continuously learn with countless internal and external training opportunities

**Zillow Group is a strategic, mission-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes.** Our work spans cross-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.

**About the role**
------------------

As a Software Development Engineer (P3) at Zillow, you are a key contributor to your team’s success. You independently deliver non-trivial features and improvements, design solutions to well-scoped problems, and help teammates succeed. You are respected for the quality of your work and your thoughtful participation in team discussions. This role is about mastering your craft, deepening your technical impact, and building the foundation for future growth. In this role you will:

  

* Work on revenue-generating features that make a real impact on the business, while growing your technical expertise.
* Collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, and designers across teams to deliver high-quality, scalable solutions.
* Be trusted to take ownership of meaningful projects, contribute to system design discussions, and strengthen the reliability and performance of our advertising platforms.
* Work across the stack: React/TypeScript micro-frontends, GraphQL federation, and backend services, plus ad-tech integrations (Google Ad Manager/GPT, Prebid, viewability and identity vendors).
* Ship experiments safely through A/B trial platforms with clear guardrail metrics, rollback paths, and data-informed decisions.
* Use AI coding assistants to amplify your expertise while exercising judgment on when to trust, revise, or set aside generated output.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Technical Program Managers, Ad Ops, and page-owner teams (Search, Home Detail Page, Rentals, iOS/Android) to adapt and extend solutions for advertising use cases.
* Help refine team processes through agile ceremonies; support growth of the team through interviewing and onboarding.
* Continuously learn: seek feedback, and deepen your knowledge of ad technology, front-end performance, and distributed systems

This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.

**Who you are**
---------------

* 4+ years designing, coding, and debugging production web applications and backend services.
* Strong proficiency in modern front-end development with React and TypeScript; experience with micro-frontend architectures, server-side rendering, and web performance optimization.
* Solid backend experience in Node.js/TypeScript and/or Java (Spring Boot); comfortable designing and consuming GraphQL APIs (federated graphs a plus).
* Experience with AWS and container/Kubernetes-based platforms, CI/CD (GitLab or similar), and observability tooling such as Datadog.
* Rigorous about quality: unit and integration testing (Jest, Playwright or equivalent), code review, monitoring.
* A track record of independently delivering well-scoped features with quality; communicates clearly with technical and non-technical partners, and seeks guidance when facing ambiguity .
* BS in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience.

**Get to know us**
------------------

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

  

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

  

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

  

*Zillow Group is committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment and to providing equal employment opportunities. We comply with applicable laws that prohibit discrimination in employment and recruitment.*

  

*If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during the recruitment process, please contact your recruiter directly.*

  

*Qualified applicants will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable law.*

title: Dist Engr-AI Science
description:
### **When you join Verizon**

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

We are seeking a visionary **Distinguished Engineer, AI Science** to lead the technical strategy, research, and development of our next-generation AI architecture focused on Customer Base Management (CVM). As a Distinguished Engineer, you will be the foremost technical authority in the organization, driving the evolution from traditional machine learning to advanced Agentic, Predictive, and Prescriptive AI systems.

You will design autonomous, AI-driven engines that maximize the lifetime value of our customer base, architecting systems that not only predict customer behavior but prescribe dynamic, real-time interventions and execute them autonomously via multi-agent frameworks.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**1. Visionary Technical Leadership & AI Strategy**

* Serve as the chief technical architect and visionary for all AI science initiatives related to Base Management, Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV), churn mitigation, and cross-sell/upsell monetization.
* Define the multi-year roadmap for integrating Agentic AI (autonomous agents, LLM-driven decision engines) into our core base management platforms.
* Bridge the gap between foundational AI research and enterprise-scale commercial impact, advising C-level executives on AI investments and technology bets.

**2. Advanced AI Modeling & Agentic Architecture**

* **Agentic AI:** Architect multi-agent systems and LLM-backed autonomous pipelines capable of executing complex customer lifecycle interventions without human-in-the-loop dependencies.
* **Predictive AI:** Oversee the development of state-of-the-art predictive models (deep learning, sequence modeling, probabilistic models) for extreme-accuracy forecasting of churn, propensity, and customer lifecycle events.
* **Prescriptive AI:** Design large-scale optimization and reinforcement learning (RL) engines that determine the "Next Best Action" (NBA), Next Best Offer (NBO), and dynamic pricing strategies in real-time.
* Pioneer the use of Generative AI for hyper-personalized base communication, ensuring safety, compliance, and brand alignment within agentic workflows.

title: Lead Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure is expanding across existing and new regions. Our Networking organization builds systems that manage Internet and backbone traffic, mitigate congestion, and reduce customer impact while enabling network operations to scale efficiently.

The Lead Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer mentors engineering teams and leads the architecture of highly scalable, interdependent distributed systems. This role identifies and eliminates performance and scalability bottlenecks for hyperscale workloads, defines scalability requirements with stakeholders, and designs elastic, high-impact systems while driving innovation in data plane platforms.

We are seeking a Lead Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer to define technical direction and lead the development of highly available, scalable network control, intelligent routing and automation systems. You will combine deep networking knowledge with software and distributed systems expertise to connect real-time observability with safe, automated routing decisions.

Your work will span autonomous traffic management, policy-driven network optimization, and software-based routing infrastructure. You will identify performance and scalability bottlenecks, define requirements with stakeholders, and design resilient services that protect customer connectivity during growth, failures, and infrastructure changes.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with broad architectural influence. Based in IDC alongside the engineering team, you will lead initiatives from design through production operations, contribute to critical implementations, and establish standards for availability, security, observability, and safe deployment. You will collaborate across engineering and operations teams while mentoring senior engineers and developing technical leadership.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Define technical strategy and architecture for scalable routing, network control, and automation systems.
* Design algorithms and distributed services for route computation, congestion management, traffic steering, fault isolation, and recovery.
* Correlate network and infrastructure signals to assess customer impact and enable safe automated responses.
* Identify performance bottlenecks and optimize capacity, resource utilization, routing convergence, and behavior under heavy load.
* Architect and build highly available, fault-tolerant systems with reliable state management, replication, automated failover, and recovery.
* Define service-level objectives, operational KPIs, telemetry, monitoring, and alerting for service health and routing outcomes.
* Establish simulation, scale testing, phased migrations, in-service upgrades, verification, and rollback practices.
* Lead production troubleshooting, incident response, and root-cause analysis; establish runbooks and drive reliability improvements.
* Integrate security controls, auditability, infrastructure as code, and automated deployment, patching, and lifecycle management.
* Contribute production-quality code, review designs and implementations, and maintain architecture and operational documentation.
* Partner with cross-functional engineering, product, and business stakeholders to define technical strategy and deliver high-impact initiatives.
* Mentor senior engineers, influence architectural direction, and promote engineering excellence through technical leadership, hiring, and knowledge sharing.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10+ years of relevant experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems, network control planes, or network automation platforms.
* Strong Linux systems and networking knowledge, including containers, process and memory behavior, network namespaces, resource isolation, and packet-level troubleshooting.
* Experience designing highly available distributed services with reliable state management, observability, overload protection, and failure recovery.
* Demonstrated ability to lead architecture and delivery across teams, resolve ambiguous requirements, communicate technical trade-offs, and mentor senior engineers.
* Deep knowledge of L2/L3 networking, routing and switching, software-defined networking, traffic engineering, and WAN technologies.
* Strong expertise in BGP and MP-BGP, IPv4/IPv6, route reflection, routing policy, and VPN address families, including practical experience with convergence and reachability troubleshooting.
* Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as Go, Python, Java, or C++, with experience in API design, concurrency, automated testing, and production debugging.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Production expertise with Junos and Juniper cRPD or comparable virtualized routing platforms.
* Experience with BGP Add-Path, Optimal Route Reflection (ORR), Prefix Independent Convergence (BGP-PIC), route-flap damping, and large-scale routing tables.
* Knowledge of MPLS, RSVP-TE, PCEP, bandwidth reservation, latency-aware routing, and shared-risk link groups.
* Experience with NETCONF, Junos XML APIs, gRPC, OpenConfig, and model-driven network automation.
* Experience tuning containerized networking workloads, including cgroups, socket buffers, veth, and SR-IOV.
* Experience with infrastructure as code, automated lifecycle orchestration, and rolling upgrades for stateful services.
* Understanding of Clos fabrics, overlay/underlay integration, ECMP behavior, and backbone transit.
* Experience building distributed active measurement and telemetry systems.
* Experience with simulation, failure injection, or formal methods to validate complex distributed-system behavior.
* Experience applying traffic prediction, machine learning, or AI techniques to network optimization, anomaly detection, or operational intelligence.

title: Senior Engineering Manager - Benefits
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, **Rippling has raised $1.85B+** from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead a high-impact platform engineering team responsible for core infrastructure and product foundations used across Rippling. This role owns multiple horizontal charters, including Data Deletion, Webscripts, Internationalisation, and Rippling Config Service. These systems sit at the intersection of platform scalability, developer productivity, compliance, configuration management, and customer-facing product quality. The ideal candidate is a strong engineering leader who can operate across ambiguous problem spaces, partner deeply with product and infrastructure teams, and build durable systems that scale with Rippling’s product surface.

### **What You’ll Do**

* Lead and grow a team of engineers working on critical platform charters.
* Own technical strategy and execution for Data Deletion, Webscripts, Internationalisation, and Rippling Config Service.
* Partner with product, design, compliance, security, and infrastructure teams to define roadmaps and delivery plans.
* Drive architecture reviews and ensure systems are reliable, scalable, maintainable, and secure.
* Establish clear ownership, operational excellence, and engineering quality across multiple platform surfaces.
* Balance short-term product needs with long-term platform investments.
* Mentor senior engineers and engineering leads, helping them grow their technical judgment and leadership.
* Improve execution rigor through planning, prioritization, metrics, incident reviews, and continuous process improvement.
* Represent the team in cross-functional forums and communicate tradeoffs clearly to senior leadership.

### **What We’re Looking For**

* 12+ years of software engineering experience, with 3+ years managing engineering teams.
* Experience leading platform, infrastructure, developer productivity, or shared product-surface teams.
* Strong technical judgment and ability to reason about distributed systems, data models, APIs, reliability, and scale.
* Proven ability to lead ambiguous, cross-functional charters with multiple stakeholders.
* Experience managing senior engineers and driving alignment across teams.
* Strong execution discipline: roadmap planning, project delivery, operational metrics, and incident follow-through.
* Ability to balance product velocity with long-term platform quality.
* Clear written and verbal communication, especially around tradeoffs and technical strategy.

### **Nice To Have**

* Experience with privacy, compliance, data lifecycle, or data deletion systems(GDPR, CCPA).
* Experience building internal platforms or frameworks used by many product teams.
* Experience with internationalisation/localisation systems.
* Experience with configuration platforms, feature/config rollout systems, or policy/config management.
* Experience with low-code, scripting, workflow, or extensibility platforms.

### **Why This Role Matters**

This team builds foundational systems that many Rippling products depend on. The role requires someone who can think like a platform owner: creating leverage for other teams, reducing duplication, improving reliability, and ensuring that core systems continue to scale as Rippling grows across products, countries, and customer segments.

### **About You**

You are a hands-on engineering leader who enjoys operating at both technical and organizational levels. You can dive into architecture when needed, but your real strength is creating clarity, building strong teams, and helping engineers deliver high-quality systems in complex environments.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

description:

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

The Software Engineering Manager would provide leadership in the design, development, and deployment of Caterpillar’s state-of-the-art digital products within the areas of e-commerce. This position is accountable for hiring, managing, and mentoring multiple software engineers and pod leads who are transforming and building a world-class eCommerce application, in line with the CAT Digital Strategy.

We are looking for a Software Engineering Manager with expertise and passion to imagine, build and develop innovative products. This is a high growth space and a big opportunity that needs a dynamic product creator. The ideal candidate will be curious, have attention to detail, be energized by a dynamic environment, be comfortable with strategic thinking while also diving deep.

If you are looking for an opportunity to lead strong development teams and build creative technology solutions that positively impact international customers, relish large ownership and diverse technologies, join our team today!

As a Software Engineering Manager, you will identify, hire, and build world-class teams of Software Engineers to define, drive, and execute on our strategic vision. You will improve/initiate processes that allow these teams to collaborate with local as well as global teams with a high degree of efficiency. You will develop teams of highly motivated and talented individuals that can collaborate with Project Managers, Product Managers and Software Engineers across the company on a high impact initiative. You will design, build and own features and programs that will delight our dealers / customers.

This key role is expected to establish and mature product software engineering capability in India. The role will report to CAT Digital India Senior Engineering Manager.

**JOB DUTIES:**

* The position supports the CAT Digital strategy, recognizes the service requirements/needs of dealers and customers, corporate and business unit goals, and gives input to leadership in formulating global concepts, strategies and plans to deliver service solutions.
* Typical internal customers include various contacts throughout Caterpillar worldwide and its subsidiaries. External contacts include various customers, dealers, and vendors throughout worldwide markets.
* The role is responsible for the overall development life cycle of the solution and manage complex projects with significant impact.
* Responsibilities include supervising a team and a project related to developing business and technical solutions.
* Work with product managers in developing a strategy and road map to provide compelling capabilities that helps them succeed in their business goals.
* Work closely with senior engineers to develop the best technical design and approach for new product development.
* Continuously improve and drive engineering best practices around software engineering & lead the craftsmanship, resilience, and scalability of our solutions. Establish durable ways of working with product peers and other internal engineering teams.
* Encourage innovation, implementation of cutting-edge technologies, including outside-of-the-box thinking, teamwork, self-organization, and diversity.
* Project management - prioritization, planning of features, Stakeholder management and tracking of commitments. Develops detailed work plans, project estimates, resource plans, and status reports. Monitors and troubleshoots performance and schedule issues.
* Career management and development of direct reports: The position is responsible for all personnel issues and performance evaluation of subordinates, as well as overall employee satisfaction for the division.
* Provides technical support, and direction to teams and pod leads. Acquires resources necessary to accomplish work on time.
* Coordinates walkthroughs and reviews; ensures conformance to standards and adherence to design specifications.
* The position is challenged to carefully evaluate problems and provide input into many possible solutions before selecting one option. Problems may be complex and can require developing and monetize new solutions.
* The leader follows general policies and guidelines for projects under his/her control to ensure specific, management goals are met and desired results are achieved. Impacts key quality goals including Customer Satisfaction, Continuous Improvement, and Reoccurring Revenue, Timeliness, Accuracy, Efficiency, Cost Savings, Process Quality, etc.
* S/he should be able to operate in a very fast paced environment where time to hit market is super critical. S/he would need to also balance technical leadership with savvy business judgment to make the right decisions about technology choices.
* Employee is also responsible for performing other job duties as assigned by Caterpillar management from time to time.

**Basic Qualifications:**
  

* Position requires a four-year degree from an accredited college or university.
* Fifteen + years or more of experience in designing and developing software applications in Java or Scala or at least ten years of experience in Java with master’s degree in computer science or related field.
* Three years or more of experience in managing 8 to 14 member cross functional team.
* Five years or more of experience in public cloud technologies such as AWS or Azure.

**Top candidates will also have:**

* Demonstrated leadership on medium to large-scale projects impacting strategic priorities.
* Ability to cope with shifting priorities, demands and timelines through analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to effectively prioritize, delegate responsibilities and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment.
* Oversees performance of individual team members and team as whole. Identifies and addresses staff training and development needs.
* Develops detailed work plans, project estimates, resource plans, and status reports. Monitors and troubleshoots performance and schedule issues.
* Ability to work under pressure and within time constraints.
    
  Passion for technology and innovation.
* Ability to provide guidance in applying the right architectural design pattern for the modernization of the applications by analysing the gaps between existing architecture and new business requirements.

**Proven experience in many of the following:**  

* Designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining software at scale.
* Application architectural patterns, such as MVC, Microservices, Event-driven, etc.
* Technical expertise in building a complex open-stack, microservices-based platform or product that is highly reliable, and scalable.
* Message brokers such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS, AWS SNS, Apache ActiveMQ, Kinesis.
* Datastores such as MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis, Elasticsearch, MySQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL.
* Developing software applications using relational and NoSQL databases.
* Deploying software using CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GoCD, Azure Devops etc.
* Working within an Agile framework (ideally Scrum).
* Researching data to support design decisions.
* Must demonstrate solid knowledge of computer science fundamentals like data structures and Algorithms.
* Preference will be given to candidates having knowledge of ecommerce platforms like HCL Commerce (WCS) Version 8.0+ or equivalent; WebSphere Commerce subsystems - Trading, Catalog Management, Order Management, Member Management Sub-system, etc
