title: Sr. Software Dev Engineer, Advertising Core Infra
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Would you like to build highly available, scalable and distributed engineering systems for one of the largest data lakes in Amazon? Does Petabyte scale excite you?  
  
Spektr is Amazon Ads' exabyte-scale central data lake: the unified catalog for petabytes of campaign, ad-serving, billing, and measurement data. Hundreds of teams and Amazon's advertiser-facing AI agents depend on it for discovery, ingestion, transformation, and querying at scale. If you want large-scale engineering with tangible business impact, this is the team.  
  
We're rebuilding Spektr ground-up with an AI-first architecture, and building fully-automated domain agents that let customers manage their big data lifecycle in a single click. In parallel, we're adopting Apache Iceberg / S3 Tables with serverless compute, scaling horizontally via a data mesh pattern for 5 growth in volume and demand. If you thrive on greenfield experimentation and shipping things that matter to the business, keep reading.  
  
As a Sr SDE on this team, you will own the core platform services that power Amazon Ads data infrastructure, consolidating legacy systems into clean, API-first services that cut job creation time from weeks to less than a day. You will build MCP-enabled AI interfaces that let AI agents create and run data pipelines on Spektr at 99%+ success rate, directly shaping how GenAI discovers and consumes data across Amazon Ads. You will design and operate high-scale Java services on AWS-native infrastructure (Spark, EMR Serverless, Kinesis, Step Functions), processing petabytes of data daily at 99.9% availability. You will also drive deployment automation, replacing manual release cycles with CI/CD pipelines that accelerate delivery velocity for a platform serving Tier-1 advertising data systems.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Engage with key decision makers such as Product & Program Managers to understand customer requirements and brainstorm on solutions
* Design, code and deploy components and micro-services for the core job management pipeline
* Ensure testability, maintanability and low operational footprint for your code
* Participate in operational responsibilities with your team
* Innovate on AWS technology to improve latency, reduce cost and operations

  
A day in the life  

* Focus on core engineering opportunities to guarantee system availability that matches our data growth
* Work with a skilled team of engineers, managers and decision makers to consistently meet customer demand
* Automate monitoring of data availability, quality and usability via simplified metrics and drive innovations to improve guarantees for our customers

  
About the team  
The mission of the Ads Datalake team is to provide data that helps the advertising organization make informed analyses and decisions for our customers and to determine and deploy investments for future growth via a set of central and unified products and services.  
  
Our team focuses on simplicity, usability, speed, compliance, cost efficiency and enabling high-velocity decision making so our customers can generate high quality insights faster.  
  
We are a global team with presence across India and North America.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Principal Member Technical Staff - Data engineer
description:
**Company Description**

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

 **Job Description**

Nielsen’s Digital Content AI team builds and operates data-processing pipelines that turn digital audience and interaction signals into reliable, analytics-ready datasets. As a principal-level individual contributor, you will bring a Solution first mindset and strong data understanding to the full lifecycle: understand new data sources, build reusable ingestion and transformation workflows, validate and enrich data, publish it to downstream data platforms, and keep production processing dependable. You will lead multiple cross-functional projects through measurable business deliverables, providing technical direction through expertise and influence rather than formal people management. You will work across mobile, Connected TV (CTV), desktop/laptop and web use cases, partnering with product, data collection, platform, quality and downstream analytics teams.  
  

* Lead the technical design and delivery of batch and near-daily data pipelines, from raw inputs through curated outputs and publication to the Master Data Layer (MDL).
* Profile and interpret incoming telemetry from diverse data sources; identify data gaps and translate source formats into dependable processing logic.
* Apply an AI-first approach to engineering and operations: identify appropriate opportunities for AI-assisted data exploration, code and test generation, classification, anomaly detection and workflow automation; validate outputs rigorously and use AI responsibly with appropriate privacy and security controls.
* Design and operate real-time and streaming event workflows alongside batch pipelines, managing event validation, schema evolution, ordering and duplication, late or replayed events, processing latency, backpressure and failure recovery.
* Build and maintain parsers, configuration-driven workflows, event/session logic, business rules and schema mappings for application usage and in-app activity across mobile, CTV, desktop/laptop and web products.
* Develop data-stitching and transformation logic that correlates relevant sources, derives sessions and engagement measures, and produces consistent intermediate and curated datasets.
* Deliver data processing for streaming/video, e-commerce and advertising use cases, including event classification, purchase and product/category/search activity, app and web usage, and incremental dataset updates.
* Integrate reference and enrichment data—including content metadata and classification inputs—where required; collaborate with machine-learning and platform teams to operationalize model-based classification and enrichment.
* Build reusable frameworks for onboarding new applications, platforms, data sources and markets; support configuration, historical backfills, reprocessing and safe daily refreshes.
* Orchestrate and operate workflows using tools such as Airflow and AWS workflow services; monitor schedules, dependencies, retries, failures and data availability, and troubleshoot production issues through root-cause analysis.
* Implement and evolve automated data-quality controls, including schema and completeness checks, freshness and volume monitoring, null/range/duplicate checks, event consistency, stitching validation and reconciliation between processing layers and MDL.
* Create and use operational dashboards, alerts and job-level telemetry to make pipeline health, data quality, performance and processing costs visible; improve reliability and efficiency based on those signals.
* Optimize distributed processing and cloud data layouts for correctness, scalability, runtime and cost, working with technologies such as Spark, Parquet, Amazon S3, AWS Glue, Athena and EMR.
* Contribute to design reviews, code reviews, testing strategy, release readiness, runbooks and technical documentation; maintain clear data contracts, schemas and operational ownership boundaries.
* Provide technical direction and mentoring to engineers, lead moderately complex initiatives through influence, and communicate risks, dependencies, estimates and delivery status to cross-functional partners.
* Drive multiple projects or workstreams end to end, translating business needs into scope, milestones and technical plans; coordinate dependencies and stakeholders; and remain accountable for quality, adoption, timelines and measurable business outcomes—not people-management responsibilities.
* Handle sensitive data responsibly and follow Nielsen’s security, privacy, access-control and engineering practices.

 **Qualifications**

* Typically 10–15 years of relevant data engineering or data processing experience, or equivalent depth of expertise delivering complex production data systems.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent practical experience; a relevant advanced degree or specialized certification is a plus.
* Expert-level SQL and strong programming skills in Python and/or Scala/Java, with substantial hands-on experience building distributed data-processing workloads using Apache Spark or a comparable framework.
* Proven experience designing, deploying and supporting production data pipelines and data-lake/lakehouse workflows on AWS or a comparable cloud platform.
* Practical experience with object storage and columnar formats such as S3 and Parquet, workflow orchestration, metadata/catalog services, and query engines such as Athena or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of data semantics and modeling, source-to-target lineage, schema evolution, data contracts, event-driven and batch-processing patterns, partitioning, incremental loads, backfills and idempotent/recoverable processing.
* Hands-on knowledge of real-time event processing concepts, including delivery guarantees, event-time handling, ordering, deduplication, replay, latency and backpressure.
* An AI-first engineering mindset and practical judgment about where AI/ML can improve data understanding, processing, quality or operational efficiency, with the ability to verify AI-generated outputs.
* Demonstrated ability to investigate unfamiliar or inconsistent source data, convert business rules into testable processing logic, and diagnose issues across multiple pipeline stages.
* A track record of independently driving multiple complex, cross-functional projects from problem definition through production delivery, with clear ownership of business outcomes and no reliance on formal people-management authority.
* Experience building data-quality checks, reconciliation, monitoring and alerting for production data products.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, sound technical judgment, and a track record of independently owning complex deliverables from discovery through production support.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical trade-offs and coordinate delivery across teams.

 **Additional Information**

* Familiarity with stitching diverse telemetry, user activity, and digital interaction signals to derive session- or content-level metrics.
* Experience with content metadata/reference-data enrichment, entity matching, e-commerce event classification, advertising datasets or ML-assisted data processing.
* Experience with AWS services such as Kinesis, Firehose, Lambda, Step Functions, Glue, Athena and EMR, and with Grafana or Datadog for operational observability.
* Experience improving reusable onboarding frameworks, pipeline resilience, data lineage, operational cost visibility or large-scale backfill processes.

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

This is a unique opportunity to lead engineers building one of the industry's most scalable cloud-native execution platforms, responsible for securely orchestrating build infrastructure across thousands of virtual machines, Kubernetes clusters, and bare-metal systems.

As an Engineering Manager, you'll lead a highly technical team responsible for architecting, scaling, securing, and operating the cloud platform that powers millions of build executions. You'll partner closely with Product Management, SRE, Customer Success, and Principal Engineers to deliver highly available infrastructure that enables developers worldwide to build software faster, more securely, and at massive scale.

**About the Role**

The Harness Cloud platform forms the foundation for Continuous Delivery (CD) and several other Harness products. As an Engineering Manager, you'll lead a team responsible for scaling and evolving the cloud infrastructure that powers our global software delivery platform.

* Lead incident response, postmortems, and continuous improvements in observability, resiliency, and operational maturity.
* Recruit, mentor, and grow engineers and technical leaders while building an inclusive, high-performing engineering culture.
* Balance execution of customer commitments with long-term investments in platform scalability, automation, and developer productivity.

**About You**
-------------

### **Proven Engineering Leader**

* 3+ years of experience leading high-performing engineering teams delivering distributed infrastructure or cloud platform services.
* Proven track record of mentoring engineers while driving technical execution and organizational growth.

### **Distributed Systems**

Strong understanding of:

* Networking

### **Technical Leadership**

### **Operational Excellence**

Experience with:

* Observability

* Logging
* Performance optimization

### **Customer Focus**

* How Harness runs 16 “startups within a startup” at scale | Jyoti Bansal

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex or national origin.

At Harness, we care about your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. For additional information on this topic, you can visit our privacy Portal: https://harness-privacy.relyance.ai/

title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
The Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) team offers the opportunity to build and operate a suite of massive-scale, coordinated cloud services in a broadly distributed, multi-tenant cloud environment. OCI is committed to delivering cloud products that meet the needs of customers tackling some of the world’s biggest challenges.

OCI Infrastructure Delivery Engineering is a growing organization responsible for building services and tools that accelerate how OCI expands its compute and network capacity. Our platform supports the full lifecycle of data centers and their physical assets—from planning and design, through delivery and operation, to eventual decommissioning. It enables OCI to grow efficiently in existing regions and launch entirely new regions while meeting the high-capacity needs of large and hyperscale customers.

We are seeking a hands-on Principal Software Development Engineer to provide technical leadership for this greenfield platform. You will define architecture and engineering strategy for highly available, scalable services that manage physical assets throughout their lifecycle. You will solve ambiguous, cross-organizational problems; establish durable technical patterns; and raise the engineering bar while remaining deeply engaged in design, implementation, operational excellence, and customer outcomes.

This role combines broad autonomy with the opportunity to integrate with existing OCI systems through well-established contracts. You will influence the direction of a foundational platform at cloud scale and help shape how OCI continues to grow its global footprint.

  

About You

* You are a hands-on cloud engineer and technical leader with a record of delivering high-scale, high-impact distributed systems.
* You turn ambiguous business and infrastructure problems into clear technical strategy, phased execution plans, and measurable outcomes.
* You care deeply about customers and consistently make sound trade-offs among reliability, security, velocity, simplicity, and cost.
* You communicate complex technical concepts clearly to engineers, product leaders, and partner teams.
* You set a high engineering bar, use data to build consensus, and constructively challenge assumptions.
* You thrive in a fast-moving environment, take ownership across organizational boundaries, and mentor engineers at multiple levels.

Minimum Qualifications

* BS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10+ years of professional software development experience, including substantial experience designing, shipping, and operating scalable, cloud-native distributed systems.
* Demonstrated technical leadership for complex, multi-service initiatives, including architecture definition, technical roadmaps, design reviews, and delivery across multiple teams.
* Strong proficiency in one or more high-level programming languages, preferably Go and/or Java; proficiency with scripting or automation languages such as Python.
* Deep experience with distributed-systems fundamentals, microservice design patterns, service-to-service communication, data consistency, fault tolerance, and highly available service design.
* Experience designing production services with robust observability, including service-level indicators/objectives, dashboards, metrics, alarms, capacity planning, and operational runbooks.
* Proven production-operations experience, including incident response, root-cause analysis, on-call practices, and driving systemic reliability improvements.
* Strong foundation in computer science concepts, including data structures, algorithms, concurrency, and programming paradigms.
* Ability to author and communicate technical proposals, architecture documents, design specifications, and presentations for diverse audiences.
* Experience mentoring engineers and improving engineering practices through code reviews, design reviews, and technical guidance.

Preferred Qualifications

* MS or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Experience building control-plane and/or data-plane solutions for a cloud provider or other large-scale infrastructure company.
* Experience with the physical asset lifecycle in cloud-scale data centers, including planning, delivery, inventory, deployment, maintenance, and decommissioning.
* Experience with Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM) systems, capacity-planning tools, or physical infrastructure workflows.
* Experience with Kubernetes, container orchestration, and modern infrastructure components such as service discovery, secret storage, containerization, and software-defined networking.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform.
* Experience diagnosing and resolving complex performance, scaling, and reliability issues in large distributed environments.
* Track record of establishing technical standards, reusable platform capabilities, or engineering practices adopted across teams.

Responsibilities

* Own and evolve the technical architecture for services and tools that accelerate OCI compute and network capacity growth.
* Lead the design and delivery of resilient, scalable, secure, and operable services for the end-to-end physical asset lifecycle.
* Translate long-term business and infrastructure goals into technical strategy, architecture roadmaps, and sequenced execution plans.
* Remain hands-on: prototype critical paths, review code and designs, solve difficult technical problems, and guide implementation of high-risk components.
* Drive alignment across engineering, product, operations, security, and partner organizations; establish clear interfaces and durable integration contracts.
* Define and champion operational-excellence standards, including observability, service health, incident learning, capacity planning, and reliability goals.
* Identify systemic risks, technical debt, and scaling bottlenecks; prioritize improvements using customer impact and data-driven analysis.
* Raise the technical bar through architectural reviews, engineering standards, technical mentorship, and constructive feedback.
* Influence major decisions for new and existing products, build consensus around trade-offs, and communicate decisions clearly to stakeholders.
* Foster a culture of ownership, continuous learning, simplicity, and iterative delivery while balancing speed with quality.

Amazon Photos empowers customers to preserve, share, and relieve their memories across mobile applications, web, desktop, Amazon devices, and as part of Alexa+. We strive to provide customers with the best memories companion for them and their families.
  
  
We're looking for a Software Development Engineer that wants to build and scale foundational services that power our computer vision and artificial intelligence capabilities. In this role, you'll architect and develop solutions that process millions of photos daily, enabling intelligent features that bring customer memories to life. You'll work at the intersection of large-scale distributed systems and AI technologies, creating services that form the backbone of Amazon Photos' next-generation features.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design and implement scalable, fault-tolerant services that power computer vision and AI features across the Amazon Photos ecosystem
* Build and optimize full-stack solutions that handle massive amounts of photo and video data while maintaining high performance and reliability
* Architect and develop ML model serving infrastructure and pipelines for real-time computer vision applications
* Drive technical decisions and architecture discussions for critical infrastructure components

* Implement and maintain observability solutions for complex distributed systems
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to building a culture of engineering excellence
* Partner with product managers and other teams to define technical roadmaps and deliver customer-facing features

  
A day in the life  
Cosmos is the foundational media and intelligence platform behind Amazon Photos, and this is a role where the code you write is felt by hundreds of millions of customers the same day it ships. You own the path that turns a raw photo into the crisp preview a customer sees the instant they open the app, serving images across every surface at up to 30,000 TPS, which makes it one of the most critical and most public experiences in the product, where performance, resilience, and graceful degradation are the job rather than nice-to-haves. You also build the computer vision and AI backbone that makes a customer's library feel intelligent, understanding what is in a photo and how good it is, picking out the best shots, recognizing people and the things that matter, spotting screenshots and text-heavy images, sharpening and enhancing older or lower quality pictures, and surfacing similar photos, so the app can curate Memories, power search, and guide editing and curation on the customer's behalf, all on a platform designed so a new capability can be added quickly rather than rebuilt from scratch, and you own the experiences that keep memories safe by making sure deletion and recovery happen correctly with the trust and privacy guarantees customers expect.
  
  
About the team  
We operate at massive scale, processing billions of customer photos while maintaining high availability and low latency. Our team leverages technologies in distributed systems, computer vision, and machine learning to create innovative solutions that delight customers. We're building the future of how people interact with their memories, using AI to create more personalized and meaningful experiences.

title: Cyber Detection Engineer
description:
**About Analog Devices**

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X .

  

**Detection Engineer – Early Career**
=====================================

  
  

**Role Overview**
=================

The Detection Engineer supports the development, testing, tuning, and maintenance of cyber detection capabilities across the Security Operations Centre (SOC). Working closely with SOC analysts, threat intelligence, incident response, and engineering teams, this role helps improve visibility, detection accuracy, and response effectiveness. This is an early-career position designed for individuals looking to build expertise in detection engineering, SIEM content development, threat analytics, and automation. The successful candidate will demonstrate curiosity, analytical reasoning, and the ability to independently investigate why a detection fired, how an attack could occur, and how future detections can be improved.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Support the development, testing, and maintenance of SIEM detection rules, analytics, alerts, and correlation logic.
* Assist with tuning existing detections to reduce false positives and improve detection quality.
* Investigate missed detections and support root-cause analysis activities.
* Work with SOC analysts to understand alert triage outcomes and improve detection content.
* Help onboard new log sources into monitoring platforms and validate data quality and coverage.
* Support detection use-case development using threat intelligence, MITRE ATT&CK, incident findings, and known attack techniques.
* Participate in threat hunting exercises and assist with developing new detection opportunities.
* Assist with maintaining detection engineering documentation, standards, playbooks, and testing records.
* Support development of automation workflows within SIEM, SOAR, and response platforms.
* Assist the SOC in the triage, investigation, and response of security alerts, incidents, and escalations
* Contribute to purple-team, tabletop, and validation exercises to measure effectiveness of detections.
* Track detection performance metrics, including false positives, false negatives, detection coverage, and alert quality.
* Support continuous improvement activities following incidents, audits, and lessons learned reviews.
* Maintain flexibility to support global cybersecurity operations, including participation in management meetings, vendor engagements, support calls, incident response activities, and after-hours escalations across multiple time zones as needed.
  

  

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 1–3 years experience in cybersecurity, IT operations, SOC operations, system administration, or related technical field.
* Understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals including phishing, malware, identity attacks, network attacks, and incident response.
* Knowledge of AI-assisted detection engineering, large language models (LLMs), agentic workflows, and security automation platforms used to improve analyst productivity and detection outcomes.
* Basic knowledge of SIEM platforms and log analysis concepts.
* Understanding of networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, authentication, and firewalls.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to learn quickly and work effectively within a collaborative team environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Experience with SIEM/SOAR platforms, Microsoft Defender, Azure, AWS, or similar platforms.
* Experience developing, integrating, or operationalizing AI-powered analysis, automation, and agent-based workflows within security operations, incident response, or detection engineering functions.
* Knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK framework.
* Basic scripting experience using Python, PowerShell, KQL, or SQL.
* Security+, SC-200, AZ-500, CySA+, or equivalent certifications.
* Experience participating in labs, CTFs, internships, threat hunting, or cyber research projects.
  

  

**Success Measures**
====================

* Improvement in detection quality and reduction in false positives.
* Successful onboarding and validation of data sources.
* Delivery of new and enhanced detection use cases.
* Contribution to incident-driven detection improvements.
* Accurate documentation and testing of detection logic.

title: AI Operations Engineering Technical Leader
description:
Meet the Team 
  
The Cisco AI Software& Platform Group incubates and delivers Generative AI based solutions to reinvent Cisco's existing Products and how customers interact with them. Our Group is also introducing new offerings that help customers roll out Generative AI at scale while doing so responsibly. Ultimately, we are doing so through internal platforms that unlock the benefits of this technology for Cisco teams and partners across our Security, Enterprise Networking, Collaboration and Splunk portfolios.
  
  
Your Impact 
  
Cisco is looking for a highly experienced and innovative DevOps Engineer to join
  
our global DevOps team. In this critical role, you will architect and build scalable, secure
  
cloud infrastructure and lead the adoption of best-in-class DevOps practices across the
  
organization. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless code
  
delivery, system reliability, and operational excellence for our SaaS platforms.
  
 
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Implement end-to-end CI/CD workflows in a large-scale, distributed environment—enabling both on-demand and scheduled builds and deployments with zero downtime.
* Scale microservice-based platforms across multiple geographic regions, with a focus on container orchestration (Kubernetes), cost optimization, and automated scaling solutions.
* Lead cross-functional DevOps projects from inception to completion defining success criteria, coordinating execution, and measuring outcomes against clear KPIs.
* Collaborate with engineering, QA, and product teams to streamline delivery pipelines and promote DevOps best practices throughout the development lifecycle.
* Advocate automation in every layer of the infrastructure stack using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles and tools such as Terraform, Helm, and GitOps frameworks.
* Continuously evaluate and adopt emerging DevOps tools and technologies to increase system resilience, reduce operational overhead, and enhance developer productivity.
* Integrate AI-assisted tooling, copilots, and AIOps into day-to-day DevOps, CI/CD workflows, infrastructure automation, testing, and incident response to enhance efficiency and system reliability.
* Participate in on-call rotation.
* Serve as a subject matter expert within the DevOps organization—promoting a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelors degree in Comp Science, Engineering (or related field /industry) + 8 years of DevOps experience, Masters + 5 years of related experience, or PhD + 3 years of related experience.
* Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines and automation tools.
* Strong proficiency in Kubernetes, Docker
* Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Solid scripting and automation skills (e.g., Python, Bash, Go).

**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Deep expertise in CI/CD tooling and practices, including hands-on experience with systems like Jenkins, Github, ArgoCD, or similar.
* Demonstrated success scaling containerized microservices across regions with cost and performance optimizations.
* Proven leadership in cross-functional engineering projects with measurable outcomes.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and mentoring skills.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
Disclaimer
  
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site

* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other thanhttps://careers.cisco.com orcisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.

title: Data Engineer
description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.

If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.

**Skills and Competencies**

* 3+ years of experience in developing and managing large-scale data infrastructure and AI applications
* Proficiency in designing and implementing scalable, fault-tolerant data infrastructure on AWS using services such as AWS Redshift, RDS, Glue, EMR, and other related tools
* Advanced skills in Python, PySpark, and SQL for efficient data manipulation and processing along with experience with data modelling and database design (SQL and NoSQL)
* Familiarity with big data technologies (e.g., Apache Spark, Hadoop) and real-time data processing solutions
* Understanding of data governance, data quality, and security best practices
* Knowledge of data streaming technologies such as Kafka, AWS Kinesis, or equivalent
* Ability to work directly with data scientists, analysts, and cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions
* Excellent communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related field
* Master’s degree in a related field, contributing added knowledge will be preferred
* AWS-related certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Data Analytics) or equivalent cloud platform credentials are highly desirable.

**Responsibilities**

As a Data Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in designing, building, and maintaining reliable data infrastructure, including pipelines and workflows that support business functions and advanced analytics. This role is crucial in ensuring the seamless integration and operation of our AI and data infrastructure.

* Design, implement, and maintain robust, scalable, and fault-tolerant ETL/ELT processes leveraging AWS services (e.g., Redshift, RDS, Glue, EMR)
* Develop and optimize data workflows using Python, PySpark, and SQL, ensuring top performance
* Work closely with data scientists, analysts, and stakeholders to gather data requirements while delivering effective solutions
* Ensure adherence to best practices related to data governance, quality, and security across all data pipelines
* Automate and optimize data processing tasks to improve reliability and reduce manual intervention
* Drive adoption of emerging big data technologies, cloud engineering, and automation practices
* Provide technical mentoring and guidance to junior team members as required
* Foster a culture of teamwork, openness, and innovation within and across teams

**About The Team**

Moody’s Ratings’ AI Analytics group develops advanced machine learning (ML) and generative AI solutions for high-profile data science initiatives. The successful candidate will guide teams in building robust, scalable, and secure solutions on AWS. The successful candidate will strive to meet Moody’s values: openness, diversity, inclusivity, respect, and a willingness to learn.

Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.  
  
Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody’s Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.

title: Data Management & Governance Program Lead
description:
**Data Management & Governance Program Lead**

**Role summary**

**Job title**

Data Management & Governance Program Lead

**Engagement**

Enterprise data management programme for a life insurer: KPI standardization, data governance, data quality and lineage, platform assessment, growth analytics, AI readiness and BAU handover

**Reports to**

Engagement Director - Capvirge; works day to day with the client’s Deputy CTO

**Leads**

Project Manager, Project Coordinator, Data Governance Analyst, Data Quality & Lineage Analyst, Business Analyst, Power BI Developers and Snowflake Data Engineer (with the client EDO team)

**Experience**

12–15+ years in data and analytics; 5+ years leading data governance or data management programmes

**Purpose of the role**

The Program Lead designs, gets approved and hands over a complete data management framework, so the business trusts its numbers and can run it without the vendor after Go-Live.

The role owns nine strategic deliverables, from KPI definitions to BAU transition, and steers the client’s EDO team on day-to-day data operations and dashboard delivery. Success means one agreed meaning for every KPI, a named owner for every data asset, proven data quality, and a client team that runs it all on its own.

The role also oversees delivery of the **16 tactical dashboards** (Power BI on Snowflake), from BRD and build to UAT sign-off, Production and BAU.

**Key responsibilities**

**Strategy and frameworks**

* Write and maintain the data management frameworks: KPI standardization, data governance, data quality and lineage, platform assessment, growth analytics, AI and automation readiness, handover, committee governance and BAU transition.
* Present frameworks and decision papers to the Steering Committee, the Data Management Committee and the Design Authority, and secure approval at each gate.

**KPIs and data governance**

* Run KPI definition workshops with each department; agree one definition, formula and owner per KPI; build the KPI Dictionary.
* Set up the governance operating model: Data Owners and Stewards, decision rights, policy, standards, data classification and committees.

**Data quality, lineage and platform**

* Identify critical data elements, define quality rules and thresholds, and set up monitoring, issue management and lineage.
* Assess the data platform (Snowflake, AWS, Power BI) for architecture, security, cost and environments; recommend a future state and remediation roadmap.

**Analytics and AI readiness**

* Map customer journeys and funnels; design reusable shared data sets for dashboards and reports.
* Assess AI readiness, rank automation and AI use cases, and set responsible AI and GenAI safety rules.

**Delivery and operations**

* Own the programme plan, RAID log, decision log, evidence repository and status reporting.
* Oversee the dashboard pipeline from BRD to UAT, Production and hypercare; unblock sign-offs with business owners.
* Guide the client EDO team on platform stability, incident and change processes, and the data request SOPs.

**Handover and BAU**

* Design BAU services, SOPs and service levels; train owners, stewards and the EDO team; lead handover acceptance and Go-Live readiness.

**Team the role leads**

**Role**

**Focus**

**Project Manager**

Programme plan, RAID log, action tracker and status reporting

**Project Coordinator**

Meetings, follow-ups, minutes and document control

**Data Governance Analyst**

Data Owners and Stewards, business glossary, policies and standards (D2)

**Data Quality & Lineage Analyst**

Data inventory, quality rules, monitoring and lineage (D3)

**Business Analyst (insurance)**

BRDs, KPI definitions and dashboard requirements (D1, D5)

**Power BI Developers**

Build, UAT and BAU support for the 16 dashboards

**Snowflake Data Engineer**

Data models, pipelines and platform remediation (D4)

**Required experience and qualifications**

* 12–15+ years in data and analytics, including 5+ years leading data governance or data management programmes end to end.
* 5+ years in insurance or financial services; life insurance strongly preferred.
* Has set up a data governance operating model (owners, stewards, decision rights, committees) and taken it through executive approval.
* Has standardized KPIs across business units and built a KPI or business glossary used in production reporting.
* Has delivered a data quality programme with critical data elements, rules, thresholds and lineage.
* Has led a platform or architecture assessment and a remediation roadmap on a modern cloud data stack.
* Has handed a programme over to a BAU team, with SOPs, training and acceptance.
* Experience as a consultant or vendor lead working with client executives.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, statistics, business or a related field; a master’s degree is a plus.

**Technical and domain skills**

**Area**

**Must have**

**Good to have**

**Data governance**

DAMA-DMBOK, federated operating models, RACI and decision rights, data classification

DCAM, data catalogue tools

**KPIs and metrics**

KPI trees, SMART definitions, certification and change control

Management scorecards and target setting

**Data quality and lineage**

Critical data elements, quality dimensions, rules and thresholds, issue management, column lineage

Automated quality checks in pipelines (Airflow), logical data models

**Data platforms**

Snowflake, AWS (S3), Power BI; environments, access control, cost (FinOps)

AWS Well-Architected, TOGAF, privileged access (CyberArk)

**Analytics**

Dashboard delivery lifecycle (BRD, UAT, hypercare), semantic models, shared data sets

Customer journey and funnel analytics

**AI readiness**

Use-case scoring; Predictive, Generative and Agentic AI concepts; responsible AI

NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001

**Insurance domain**

Life and ILP products, persistency, APE, claims, IFRS 17 and statutory reporting, bancassurance and digital partners

Group insurance

**Regulation (Philippines)**

Data Privacy Act (RA 10173), Insurance Commission requirements, RA 11765 consumer protection

AML (RA 9160)

**Delivery and service**

Programme planning, RAID, gates, change control; BAU service design, SOPs, incident and change processes

ITIL, ADKAR change management

**Behavioural competencies**

* **Executive influence:** gets decisions and sign-offs from senior leaders and busy business owners, and keeps approvals moving.
* **Plain-language communication:** turns frameworks into short material executives can read and act on.
* **Facilitation:** runs workshops where departments disagree, and brings them to one agreed definition.
* **Pragmatism:** balances good-practice governance with what a small team can actually run.
* **Ownership:** works without close supervision, and tracks commitments to closure.
* **Coaching:** builds capability in client teams so they can run the work after handover.

**Preferred certifications**

None is mandatory; proven delivery counts for more.

* CDMP (DAMA) or DCAM: data management
* PMP or PRINCE2: programme delivery

title: Senior Technology Engineer, Backup & Storage
description:
### **About the Role**

Our client, a leading Middle East banking group, is looking for a Senior Technology Engineer to own the engineering lifecycle of its backup, storage, and cyber recovery platforms. You will design, build, automate, and run a standardised stack of infrastructure products used across the organisation. The environment is high availability, high transaction volume, and globally distributed, so resilience and recoverability are non-negotiable.

The role sits in a matrix structure, reporting to the head of the infrastructure engineering function while working within a platform squad that drives delivery across design, development, implementation, standardisation, automation, and capacity planning. The ideal candidate is a T-shaped engineer: deep in Linux and data protection, broad enough to move across DevOps, cloud, and virtualisation as projects require.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Data Protection and Cyber Recovery**

* Design, implement, and maintain enterprise backup and recovery solutions across on-premise, virtualised, and cloud workloads
* Build and operate cyber recovery capabilities, including isolated recovery vaults, immutable backups, air-gapped copies, and ransomware recovery testing
* Define and enforce backup policies, retention schedules, and RPO/RTO targets aligned with regulatory and business requirements
* Run regular restore and DR drills, and document recoverability evidence for audit
* Manage storage capacity planning, performance tuning, and lifecycle of storage and backup infrastructure

**Technology Engineering**

* Act as the Linux subject matter expert, covering hardening, patching, and OS compliance against security baselines
* Automate deployment, configuration, and backup operations using Infrastructure as Code and configuration management tools
* Manage virtualisation environments and their integration with backup platforms
* Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure, storage, and application issues with development and operations teams
* Configure compute, storage, and networking services on Azure, AWS, or OCI, including cloud native backup

**Delivery**

* Own projects from inception to production, covering design, build, test, handover, and BAU support
* Apply DevOps, SRE, IaC, and 12 Factor principles to infrastructure delivery
* Integrate platform components into CI/CD pipelines
* Contribute to technology stack reduction and platform cost optimisation targets
* Handle BAU incidents and root cause analysis for backup failures and storage issues

**Stakeholder Management**

* Work with the wider infrastructure team to keep deliverables consistent across platforms
* Collaborate with the security function to align with security standards and contribute to design forums
* Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and manage expectations under pressure

### **Requirements**

**Essential**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or related field
* 10+ years in infrastructure engineering or operations, with at least 3 years in a similar senior role
* Strong hands-on experience with enterprise data protection platforms such as Commvault, Veritas NetBackup, Dell PowerProtect / Avamar / Data Domain, Veeam, Rubrik, or Cohesity
* Practical experience with cyber recovery solutions such as vault architectures and immutable storage
* Expert Linux administration (RHEL, Oracle Linux, or similar)
* Solid understanding of enterprise storage (SAN, NAS, object storage)
* Experience with virtualisation technologies, ideally VMware
* Infrastructure as Code experience, preferably Terraform, plus configuration management with Ansible or similar
* Exposure to Kubernetes or OpenShift and backup of containerised workloads
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and integrations
* Hands-on configuration of public cloud services on Azure, AWS, or OCI
* Experience in large, complex enterprises with high availability requirements, ideally banking or financial services

**Desirable**

* Certifications such as Commvault Professional, Veritas NetBackup, Dell Data Protection, RHCE, VMware VCP, CKA, or Azure/AWS associate level
* Knowledge of banking regulatory requirements around data retention and resilience
* Scripting in Python, Bash, or PowerShell

### **Behavioural Competencies**

* Self-starter with strong initiative
* Calm and methodical under pressure, especially during incidents and recovery events
* Pragmatic and outcome focused
* Willing to learn and adopt new technologies
* Clear, structured communicator

title: Software Engr II
description:
We are seeking a Senior Test Automation Engineer with a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience to join our Quality and Automation Team. The role will be approximately 80% automation and 20% manual testing, with primary responsibility for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable automation solutions for cloud-based and web-based cybersecurity applications, complemented by focused exploratory, functional, and release-validation activities. The successful candidate will collaborate closely with product development, cybersecurity, DevOps, quality, and validation teams to accelerate delivery, improve coverage, and strengthen product quality

  

Qualifications and Experience

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Electronics, Instrumentation, Electronics and Communication Engineering, or a related discipline.

* Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in software testing and test automation, with demonstrated delivery in roles primarily focused on automation and supported by hands-on manual testing.

* Demonstrated experience as a core contributor or technical lead for automation solutions supporting cloud-based or web-based applications.

* Strong software engineering fundamentals, including object-oriented design, data structures, design patterns, debugging, and source-control practices.

* Practical experience in test design, exploratory testing, defect reporting, regression testing, and release validation, with the ability to determine which scenarios should remain manual and which should be automated.

* Experience working in Agile product-development environments and collaborating with geographically distributed teams.

Mandatory Technical Skills

* The following skills and experience are mandatory for this role:

* Advanced proficiency in at least one automation-oriented programming language as Python, Java or JavaScript/TypeScript.

* Hands-on experience with web automation frameworks such as Playwright, Selenium, or Cypress.

* Strong experience in API automation and validation using REST clients, libraries, or frameworks.

* Experience with unit and test frameworks such as PyTest, JUnit, TestNG, NUnit, or equivalent.

* Working knowledge of cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud, including services, identity, networking, logging, and deployment concepts.

* Experience in integrating automation into CI/CD systems such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI.

* Proficiency with Git-based workflows, code reviews, branching strategies, and build pipelines.

* Experience with containers and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.

* Good understanding of web technologies, authentication and authorization mechanisms, certificates, APIs, databases, and distributed-system fundamentals.

* Ability to diagnose failures using logs, traces, monitoring data, and systematic debugging techniques.

* Understanding of secure software-development practices and common cybersecurity concepts relevant to cloud and web applications.

Additional Skills

* Experience automating cybersecurity products, security platforms, connected systems, or enterprise software.

* Knowledge of security testing concepts, including vulnerability management, identity and access management, encryption, audit logging, and role-based access control.

* Experience with performance, reliability, resilience, or security-focused automation.

* Experience designing automation for multi-tenant SaaS platforms or microservices-based applications.

  

Key Responsibilities

* Spend approximately 80% of the role owning the architecture, design, development, and maintenance of automation frameworks for cloud and web-based cybersecurity applications.

* Build reusable automation libraries, utilities, services, and test infrastructure that support functional, integration, API, UI, system, and end-to-end validation.

* Develop reliable automation using appropriate programming languages and frameworks, with emphasis on clean code, modular design, maintainability, and scalability.

* Automate REST API, web UI, backend service, and cloud workflow validation across supported environments.

* Integrate automated suites with CI/CD pipelines and enable scheduled, on-demand, and release-gating execution.

* Analyze failures, identify product and framework defects, perform root-cause analysis, and drive timely resolution with cross-functional teams.

* Spend approximately 20% of the role on risk-based manual testing, including exploratory testing, complex scenario validation, usability checks, and release verification where automation is not practical or has not yet been implemented.

* Define automation strategy, coding standards, review practices, quality metrics, and technical roadmaps.

* Review code, mentor engineers, troubleshoot complex issues, and provide technical leadership within the automation team.

* Collaborate with product development, cybersecurity, DevOps, quality, and validation stakeholders to understand requirements and improve testability.

* Translate suitable manual test scenarios into maintainable automated coverage, while documenting justified manual-only coverage and associated risks.

* Maintain clear technical documentation, execution reports, dashboards, traceability, and evidence required for releases.

* Evaluate tools and technologies, lead proof-of-concept activities, and continuously improve automation efficiency, reliability, and coverage.

* Follow secure coding, credential-management, data-protection, and cybersecurity best practices throughout the automation lifecycle.

  
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. title: Software Development Engineer 1
description:
**About the Team & Role**

Team builds the infrastructure that keeps commercial drivers and fleets moving from fuel payments at the pump to the apps and backend services that power authorizations, loyalty, and real-time transaction data. As an SDE I, you'll join one of two full-stack engineering teams within WEX's Mobility organization.

  
  

Both teams own their systems end to end. The 10-4 (OTR) team builds the over-the-road platform customer-facing APIs, event-driven microservices (Java/Spring Boot, Python), Kafka-based async

processing, payment and identity integrations (Fiserv, Okta), and the Android and iOS apps that drivers use in the field. The NA Mobility Platform team builds and owns the shared frontend infrastructure that product teams across the organization depend on Angular micro-frontends with NestJS BFFs, Module Federation, a shared component library (Theseus UI), brand theming, and app scaffolding via Theseus Builder. In both cases, you'll work across layers of a real production stack, ship to real users, and be supported by engineers who care about doing the work well. We value clean APIs, strong testing habits, and engineers who improve the systems they touch. You'll work closely with the product, other OTR teams, and your peers on features from design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support.

  
  

**How You'll Make an Impact**

* Build specific components within an established architecture.
* You'll follow the patterns your team has set, whether that's microservices, event-driven design, or component-based frontend, and implement features correctly within those structures rather than redefining them.
* Write clean, compilable code with unit tests that meet the team's quality standards.
* Before you start building, you'll ask the right questions about acceptance criteria and error states so you're solving the right problem, not just writing code.
* Identify and fix bugs in well-defined tasks.
* You'll reproduce issues, pinpoint where in the code they're happening, and work with senior engineers to land the right fix rather than just patching the symptom.
* Handle low-priority support tickets as a first responder and participate in on-call rotations under supervision.
* During incidents, you'll run specific checks and scripts as directed, building your confidence with live systems gradually and safely.
* Contribute to basic observability by adding error and info logging that helps the team debug issues.
* You won't be expected to triage complex production problems alone, but your logs should make it easier for others to do so.
* Keep the team's process running smoothly. That means updating Jira daily, following the
* Definition of Done, moving tickets through the right stages, and raising a flag immediately if something is at risk.
* You don't deviate from the team's agreed process without checking first.
* Show up fully in team rituals like standups, backlog grooming, and demos.
* You'll listen to stakeholder feedback during demos to understand how your work actually lands with users, not just whether it passed the acceptance criteria.
* Use AI tools like Cursor or similar to reduce boilerplate, get unstuck faster, and understand error messages more quickly. You own the quality of everything you ship though, which means validating AI-generated output rather than passing it through unchecked.
* Update documentation when you find something inaccurate or missing. Good documentation is part of the job, and you'll be expected to keep it honest as you learn the system.
  

  

**Experience You'll Bring**

* You have a solid grounding in data structures, algorithms, and software design from a B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science from a reputed institution, with 0 to 1 year of professional experience.
* You're comfortable writing clean, compilable, tested code in at least one of Java, Python, or TypeScript/JavaScript, and you understand what makes code maintainable, not just functional.
* You understand the testing pyramid and have written unit tests as part of coursework, an internship, or a personal project. You see tests as part of the feature, not an afterthought.
* You know never to hardcode secrets, you have a basic understanding of IAM and role-based access control, and you're willing to learn which compliance requirements like PCI or SOC apply to the systems you work on.
* You know your way around Git and pull requests, can deploy to an existing CI/CD pipeline, and can tell when your specific commit caused a build failure.
* When you're blocked, you ask focused questions and explain what you've already tried. You flag a deadline risk the moment you see it, not the day before it's due.
* You receive code review feedback without getting defensive, you actively learn your team's standards and tools, and you're comfortable switching between tasks within a project when priorities shift.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* A degree in computer science software engineering from a reputed institution.
* Internship or co-op experience where you shipped real code to a production or staging environment as part of a team.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a cross-functional team.
* Familiarity with cloud basics even through coursework or personal projects.
* Exposure to containerization through Docker. Reading and running existing Dockerfiles counts, you don't need to have written them from scratch.
* Some experience working in an existing codebase, contributin improvements, and navigating code you didn't write yourself.
* Awareness of AI tools beyond code completion, such as experimenting with prompt design or modifying a simple AI-powered script or agent.
* A genuine interest in the domain. Payments, fleet operations, or developer platform work are exciting problem spaces and it helps to be curious about the industry, not just the technology.

title: Data Engineer III - Databricks, Pyspark, Python, AWS
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Be part of a dynamic team where your distinctive skills will contribute to a winning culture and team.
  
  
As a Data Engineer III - Databricks, Pyspark, Python, AWS at JPMorgan Chase within the Commercial & Investment Bank, you'll serve as a seasoned member of an agile team to design and deliver trusted data collection, storage, access, and analytics solutions in a secure, stable, and scalable way. You are responsible for developing, testing, and maintaining critical data pipelines and architectures across multiple technical areas within various business functions in support of the firm's business objectives.
  
  
**Job responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain **big data pipelines** (**batch** and **streaming**) using **PySpark/Spark** and **Databricks**.
* Lead/own **data modelling** and **solution design** for data products, including defining target-state architecture, data flows, and transformation patterns.
* Build scalable ingestion and transformation workflows for **high-volume datasets**, ensuring **reliability**, **quality**, and **performance**.
* Develop and optimize complex **SQL** transformations, reconciliation queries, and analytical datasets; perform **query tuning** for large-scale workloads.
* Apply strong **data warehousing concepts** (**dimensional modeling**, **SCDs**, **partitioning strategies**, etc.) to build well-structured, analytics-ready data layers and Leverage common **AWS services**, with strong emphasis on **S3** and AWS **data processing capabilities**, to support scalable storage and processing.
* Perform advanced **debugging** and **troubleshooting** across distributed **Spark** workloads (**data skew**, **shuffle tuning**, **memory/compute optimization**).
* Implement engineering best practices: **modular design**, **efficient coding**, **code reviews**, and **CI-friendly** development approaches.
* Use **GitHub/Bitbucket** and standard **version control** workflows to manage codebase, peer reviews, and releases.
* Partner with **cross-functional stakeholders** to convert requirements into robust **big data solutions**.
* Uses enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to accelerate data pipeline/design analysis and documentation, validating outputs and handling data according to sensitivity and security requirements.
* Applies reuse-first, AI-assisted practices to strengthen SDLC-quality routines for data pipelines (e.g., test generation and control validation), ensuring traceability/auditability and alignment to resiliency and security expectations.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Formal training or certification on data engineering concepts and 3+ years applied experience
* Experience in **data engineering / big data engineering**, with strong hands-on delivery and Expert-level **SQL** skills (must be extremely strong): complex joins, **window functions**, **CTEs**, optimization, and **analytical problem solving** at scale.
* Strong hands-on coding experience with **Python** in production environments; demonstrated ability to write **efficient**, **maintainable** code.
* Deep expertise in **Apache Spark (in depth)** and **PySpark**, including **performance tuning** and **distributed processing fundamentals**.
* Strong experience with **Databricks** for large-scale data processing and pipeline development.
* Strong understanding of **data warehousing concepts** and best practices; proven capability in **data modelling** and **solution design** for scalable, maintainable data platforms/products.
* Experience implementing both **batch** and **streaming** data processing solutions.
* Familiarity with **AWS S3** and common **AWS services** used in data platforms and processing
* Excellent **debugging**, **troubleshooting**, **problem-solving** skills and experience with **GitHub**, **Bitbucket**, and **version control** best practices.
* Demonstrated experience using enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to support data engineering workflows with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity.
* Ability to review and validate AI-assisted outputs (e.g., query suggestions, test ideas, or model change summaries) before use, escalating when uncertain and following data handling requirements.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Good to have: infrastructure provisioning in **AWS** using **Infrastructure as Code (IaC)** (e.g., **Terraform**, **AWS CloudFormation**).

Morgan and Chase brands.
