This is the platform that helps the world's largest enterprises see how work actually happens inside their organizations, and act on that understanding. It is technically complex, data-intensive, and genuinely impactful at scale.

We are looking for someone who has spent meaningful time in process mining, process intelligence, or intelligent automation. Not just an awareness of the space, but real product experience in it. You know the gap between a compelling demo and something that actually works in a large enterprise environment. You have shipped products in this domain and have the scars to show for it.

With 12 to 15 years of product experience, including time at AI-native startups, you are comfortable making product calls with incomplete information, working without a lot of support structure around you, and keeping a team focused when everything feels urgent. You are also someone who uses AI tools every day in how you work, not just in what you build. That matters to us.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Vision and Strategy**

* Own the product roadmap for the process intelligence platform, from how we capture and model operational data through to the analytics and prescriptive insights we surface to customers.
* Make clear, defensible decisions on what we build next. You will get input from customers, from sales, from data, and from the competitive landscape. Your job is to synthesize all of that and land on a prioritized point of view.
* Keep the company aligned on product direction. That means being a consistent voice in leadership discussions, not just a person who maintains a roadmap document.
Know the competitive landscape well. Understand what Celonis, SAP Signavio, UiPath, and the broader BPM and automation ecosystem are doing. Use that knowledge to sharpen Skan's positioning and find the white space.  

  

**Product Execution and Delivery**

* Work closely with engineering, design, and data science to turn complex customer problems into product requirements teams can actually build from. Good PRDs, clear acceptance criteria, and regular communication matter here.
* Manage delivery across several workstreams at once, covering process discovery, analytics, conformance, and integrations. Help teams make smart trade-off decisions when timelines get tight.
* Stay engaged with architecture and data model decisions that affect the product. You do not need to write the code, but you need to understand what is being built and why certain technical choices matter at enterprise scale.
Hold a high bar for user experience. Process intelligence data is inherently complex. Making it feel accessible and actionable to both business users and technical users is one of the harder product challenges in this space.  

  

**Using AI in How You Work**

We are an AI company. We expect product leaders to work with AI tools every day, not just build products that use them. This is what that looks like in practice.

* Use LLMs and AI research tools to move faster in discovery. Summarize customer interviews, identify patterns across large volumes of feedback, and sharpen your hypotheses without spending days manually reviewing notes.
* Use generative AI to write better first drafts of PRDs and specifications. Spend your energy making judgment calls and refining thinking, not starting from a blank page every single time.
* Set up workflows to track what is happening in the market. Use AI tools to monitor competitor releases, analyst commentary, and community signals across the process mining and automation space so you are never behind.
* Bring your team along. Help your product managers develop real fluency with these tools, including knowing when to trust AI output and when to push back on it.
* Stay grounded in what AI can and cannot do reliably inside enterprise products. That practitioner perspective will directly shape how we build and talk about AI features in the platform.
Share what you learn. Recommend tools, document what works, and help build an internal culture of AI-augmented work across the product organization.  

  

**Team Leadership**

* Build and grow the product management team. That means hiring thoughtfully, giving people real ownership of meaningful problems, and being the kind of manager whose reports get better over time.
* Set up the operating model. Good product teams do not run themselves. Help establish the rituals, frameworks, and ways of working that let people move fast without losing sight of what matters.
Create an environment where people are honest about trade-offs, comfortable sitting with uncertainty, and focused on outcomes over activity.  

  

**Customer and Commercial Engagement**

* Spend real time with customers. Get into the detail of how they use the product, where it falls short, and what they actually need. Use those conversations to challenge your assumptions, not just confirm them.
* Show up in executive-level customer conversations and sales cycles as a credible product voice. You should be able to walk a customer through where the product is heading and why it matters to their specific business.
Work with Customer Success to track how customers are getting value from the platform and use those signals to sharpen what we build next.  

  

**Cross-Functional Alignment**

* Help Sales and Marketing tell a sharper product story. That means going beyond feature lists and helping them articulate what actually makes Skan different in a crowded market.
* Collaborate with Finance and leadership when business cases need product input, whether that involves pricing, packaging, or expansion opportunities.
Stay close to what Professional Services and Customer Success teams see on the ground. Some of the most useful product insights come from the people who spend the most time with customers post-sale.  

  

**Qualifications and Experience**

* 12 to 15 years of professional experience, with at least 8 years in product management in enterprise software or SaaS.
* You have worked at an AI-native startup. You know what it is like to build under pressure, make product calls without full information, and keep moving without a lot of infrastructure around you.
* Background in process mining, process intelligence, BPM, task mining, or RPA is strongly preferred. Candidates with this domain experience will stand out. If you have worked at companies like Celonis, UiPath, SAP Signavio, ABBYY, Minit, or similar, we want to hear from you.
* Real familiarity with process mining concepts: how event logs work, what conformance checking involves, how process discovery surfaces insights, and what makes process KPIs meaningful to an enterprise buyer.
* You understand how AI and ML get applied in operational intelligence products. Not just the theory. You have worked through the practical realities of model development, validation, and how insights actually reach end users.
* You have shipped products used by large enterprises. You understand procurement cycles, compliance requirements, and what it takes to get something adopted at scale inside a Fortune 500 organization.
* You have led product teams before. People grew under your management. You know how to give teams real ownership while keeping everyone pointed in the same direction.
* You are technically credible. You can have a substantive conversation with engineers and data scientists about architecture decisions, API design, and data pipeline trade-offs without needing someone to translate.
* You use AI tools in your day-to-day work and can speak specifically about what you use them for and what impact they have had. This is a real expectation, not a checkbox.
* You communicate clearly across very different audiences, from a technical spec reviewed by engineers to a roadmap presentation in front of a board.
You can operate in ambiguous situations without becoming paralyzed. Fast-moving, early stage environments energize rather than frustrate you.  

  

**Education**

A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field is required. An MBA or advanced degree in a quantitative or business discipline is a strong plus.

  

**What Success Looks Like in the First 12 Months**

* You have built a product roadmap that the whole company believes in and that customers are genuinely excited about.
* You have shipped meaningful improvements to the process intelligence platform that customers are using, talking about, and renewing because of. • The product team is operating well. People have clear ownership, they are growing in their roles, and there is a culture of honest feedback and continuous learning.
* Skan's process intelligence story is sharper and more differentiated in the market. That is visible in customer conversations, analyst coverage, and competitive win rates.
* You have introduced AI-assisted ways of working into how the team runs discovery, writes specifications, and tracks the competitive landscape. It has made a measurable difference.
People across Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and leadership come to you when they need the product perspective. You have earned that trust through good judgment and clear communication.  

  

Skan AI is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace around the world. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion or belief, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital or family status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws in the locations where we operate. We welcome people from all backgrounds and provide reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process.

title: FinOps Engineer
description:
Posting Description:

Aon plc (NYSE:AON) is a leading global professional services firm providing a broad range of risk, retirement, and health solutions. Our 50,000 colleagues in 120 countries empower results for clients by using proprietary data and analytics to deliver insights that reduce volatility and improve performance.

Join Aon Services Corporation as a FinOps Engineer where you will spearhead the flawless execution of day-to-day FinOps practices. These include cost monitoring, tagging governance, anomaly detection, and optimization recommendations. Your role will be pivotal in supporting the FinOps Lead to drive cloud cost efficiency across our outstanding technology estate.

Key Responsibilities

* Monitor cloud spend daily/weekly across AWS, Azure, and GCP; investigate and flag anomalies
* Build and maintain world-class cost dashboards and reports (showback/chargeback) for engineering teams
* Enforce and audit resource tagging/labeling standards for detailed cost allocation
* Identify rightsizing, idle-resource, and storage-tier optimization opportunities and collaborate with engineering teams to implement them
* Support Reserved Instance/Savings Plan/Committed Use Discount purchase recommendations and utilization tracking
* Maintain FinOps tooling integrations and data pipelines feeding cost dashboards
* Document cost optimization playbooks and guidelines
* Assist with monthly and quarterly cost reviews and forecast variance analysis

Required Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* 10+ years of proven experience in cloud operations, DevOps, or IT financial analysis
* FinOps Certified Practitioner (FOCP) certification preferred
* Working knowledge of at least one public cloud platform's billing/cost console

Technical Skills

* Proficiency with cloud cost tools: AWS Cost Explorer/CUR, Azure Cost Management, GCP Billing export/BigQuery, Cloudability/CloudHealth
* Skilled in SQL and spreadsheet-based cost analysis; experience with BI tools (Power BI, Looker, Tableau)
* Scripting abilities (Python or similar) for automated reporting
* Expertise in resource tagging governance and cost allocation frameworks
* Basic understanding of cloud infrastructure including compute, storage, and networking

Skills You'll Use Every Day

* Demonstrated analytical rigor and attention to detail
* Strong ownership and follow-through
* Clear written and verbal communication
* Effective collaboration with engineering and finance collaborators
* Continuous improvement approach

**How we support our colleagues**
---------------------------------

In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we encourage a diverse workforce. Plus, our agile, inclusive environment allows you to manage your wellbeing and work/life balance, ensuring you can be your best self at Aon. Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging you to take time to focus on yourself. We offer a variety of working-style solutions, but we also recognize that flexibility goes beyond just the place of work... and we are all for it. We call this Smart Working!

Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips you to learn, share and grow, helping you achieve your fullest potential. As a result, at Aon, you are more connected, more relevant, and more valued.

Aon values an innovative, diverse workplace where all colleagues feel empowered to be their authentic selves. Aon is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

title: GIS Engineer - Esri ArcGIS Platform
description:
**Company Description**

Egis is a leading global consulting, construction engineering and operating firm. We work together with our clients, across every aspect of transport, energy, and the built environment to build a more balanced, sustainable, and resilient world. The Egis Group has more than 50 years of experience and a team of 25,500 employees in over 70 countries around the world. Joining our Group means, above all, sharing our values as a people-first company, strongly committed to sustainability and innovation.

In the UK and Ireland, we are proud to be delivering some of the most iconic projects which help connect people, protect our environment, and meet emission reduction targets. From highways, rail and operations and maintenance, to energy, water, nuclear and smart infrastructure, clients choose us to help them solve their most complex challenges - delivering climate-responsible growth that meets the needs of communities, industry and the planet.

 **Job Description**

We are seeking a **GIS Engineer – Esri ArcGIS Platform** to provide Level 3 support and administration for the Group's ArcGIS ecosystem. The successful candidate will work closely with the GIS Core Team, Group IT, and Esri Support to ensure the reliability, performance, security, and continuous improvement of the ArcGIS platform.

This role is ideal for professionals with strong hands-on experience in **ArcGIS Enterprise administration, technical support, platform upgrades, and geospatial data management**. Candidates with prior experience in Esri Technical Support, Esri Partners, or Esri Distributors will be highly valued.

Key Responsibilities

**Level 3 Support & User Assistance**

* Provide advanced technical support through ServiceNow and resolve complex GIS incidents and service requests.
* Troubleshoot and support ArcGIS Enterprise services, publishing workflows, editing operations, performance issues, and access management.
* Act as the escalation point for Level 2 support teams and mentor them to improve issue resolution capabilities.
* Collaborate with Group IT teams on Azure infrastructure, networking, server management, and security-related matters.
* Maintain accurate documentation of incidents, troubleshooting actions, and resolutions.

**ArcGIS Platform Administration**

* Administer and maintain ArcGIS Enterprise environments, including Portal for ArcGIS, ArcGIS Server, ArcGIS Data Store, and Web Adaptor.
* Manage ArcGIS Online subscriptions, users, groups, roles, and licensing.
* Perform backup and restore operations using WebGISDR and participate in disaster recovery testing.
* Apply patches, monitor platform health, and contribute to system performance optimization.
* Manage authentication and security integrations, including Microsoft Entra ID and SAML.
* Participate in ArcGIS Enterprise upgrades and migrations, including planning, compatibility validation, testing, rollback planning, deployment, and user communication.

**Data Management & Automation**

* Administer Enterprise Geodatabases hosted on PostgreSQL and Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Flexible Server.
* Manage schemas, permissions, versioning, replication, archiving, and database performance tuning.
* Monitor storage utilization, indexing, maintenance routines, and overall database health.
* Develop automation tools and scripts using ArcPy and ArcGIS API for Python.
* Maintain code repositories in GitLab, including version control, code reviews, and CI/CD processes.
* Coordinate with Esri Support and the GIS Core Team on technical issues, platform improvements, and roadmap initiatives.

  
**Qualifications**

**Technical Skills**

* 3-7 years of GIS experience, including a minimum of 3 years supporting or administering ArcGIS Enterprise.
* Strong hands-on experience with ArcGIS Enterprise administration and troubleshooting.
* Expertise in WebGISDR backup, restore, and deployment integrity validation.
* Experience providing Level 3 or advanced Level 2 support in enterprise environments.
* Strong PostgreSQL database administration skills, including enterprise geodatabases, SQL, and performance tuning.
* Experience with Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Flexible Server.
* Good understanding of Microsoft Azure services, including Virtual Machines, Storage, and Entra ID.
* Proficiency in Python scripting using ArcPy and ArcGIS API for Python.
* Experience with ServiceNow or similar ticketing platforms.
* Ability to develop, review, and improve technical operating procedures.

**Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in GIS, Geomatics, Geography, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior technical support experience with Esri, an Esri Distributor, or an Esri Partner.
* Esri certifications such as ArcGIS Enterprise Administration.
* Experience performing ArcGIS Enterprise upgrades and migrations.
* Knowledge of Esri product lifecycle management, including Long-Term Releases (LTR) and support policies.
* Experience with ArcGIS Monitor, Experience Builder, Survey123, Field Maps, Dashboards, and related solutions.
* Knowledge of Open-Source GIS technologies such as QGIS and PostGIS.
* Experience with Git/GitLab and ITIL Foundation certification.

**Key Competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Methodical and process-driven approach to technical support and administration.
* Ability to challenge, improve, and document operational procedures.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Customer-service mindset with the ability to support global users.
* Self-motivated, dependable, and collaborative team player.
* Fluent spoken and written English.
* French language proficiency is an added advantage.

  
**Additional Information**

**Equality, Diversity & Inclusion**

We are an Equal Opportunities employer and we strive to build a workforce that truly reflects the communities we represent. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender identity, gender expression, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and any other protected characteristic. If you decide to apply for an opportunity with us, your application will be assessed based purely on your experience, the essential and desirable criteria, and your suitability for the role. We value each and every one’s contribution as this builds our culture and means that if you work with us, you will be included, listened to, and respected.

title: Cyber Manager - Threat Exposure Management (Infrastructure)
description:
**Job Role- Cyber Manager**  
The Cyber Manager for Threat Exposure Management is responsible for leading [as a people manager] the enterprise-wide operations, and continual evolution of the organisation’s threat exposure management lifecycle and reduction programmes within a given scope, and reports to the *Senior Cyber Manager – Threat Exposure Management* . This role ensures that exposures across infrastructure, applications, identities, cloud, OT/IoT, AI, and third-party ecosystems are proactively identified, prioritised, validated, and remediated in alignment with business risk and operational resilience requirements.

The successful candidate must demonstrate a strong track record in leading [also as a people manager] high-performing technical teams and fostering a culture of technical excellence. They will bring market-proven know-how to establish industry-driven threat exposure management practices, whilst effectively influencing stakeholders across the organisation. The candidate must also bring advanced technical expertise in threat exposure, vulnerability management and defensive and offensive security, with the ability to lead deep technical discussions and conduct complex analysis across some of the following technologies: IT, OT, Cloud, Applications, Data, Identities, Code and AI-driven environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead the technical direction and operational governance of Threat Exposure and Vulnerability Management across heterogeneous environments, including enterprise IT, OT/ICS systems (PLC, SCADA, DCS), multi-cloud architectures (such as Azure, AWS, GCP), container platforms, Kubernetes clusters, application stacks, CI/CD pipelines, Data, Identity, source-code repositories and AI/ML ecosystems.
* Oversee the full threat exposure lifecycle: continuous asset discovery, authenticated scanning, passive/active enumeration, exploitability analysis, threat correlation, prioritisation logic, risk acceptance workflows and exception governance.
* Ensure end-to-end integration with asset intelligence platforms, CMDB, CSPM, vulnerability scanners, code-security toolchains (SAST, SCA, DAST, IaC, secret scanning), and ASM/EASM technologies, establishing high-fidelity visibility across all attack-surface domains.
* Collaborate with Threat Intelligence to operationalise threat-led prioritisation, mapping exploit campaigns, adversary TTPs and industry-specific threat trends to internal exposure data. Align Vulnerability Management (VM) and Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM) with predictive models and real-time intel feeds.
* Direct technical coordination with Red Team and Incident Response to validate exploit paths, confirm actual attack feasibility, and translate validation findings into actionable remediation and control enhancements, partnering with Protect capability and Issues Engineers.
* Govern cloud exposure management across CSPs, ensuring deep visibility into misconfigurations, identity privileges, network paths, storage exposures, API endpoints and container orchestration layers.
* Extend VM and CTEM coverage into OT/ICS environments with risk-aware, non-disruptive methods. Coordinate with OT Security teams to identify vulnerabilities, weak configurations, outdated firmware, and unmanaged assets.
* Manage Vulnerability and Threat Exposure Management across Identity services, including account hygiene, privileged-access pathways, directory health, DNS/DHCP configurations, PKI integrity, authentication flows, domain controller posture, and any identity-linked misconfigurations that create exploitable attack paths.
* Oversee AI/ML exposure across data ingestion pipelines, model training and deployment layers, ensuring identification of risks such as model inversion, data poisoning, prompt injection, insecure model APIs and ungoverned LLM integrations. Operational Excellence & Quality Obsession · Maintain functional metrics and KPIs, delivering performance at or above agreed targets to support operational excellence.
* Develop and uphold operational dashboards, SOPs, workflows, playbooks and service definitions, ensuring high-quality, consistent, standards-driven service delivery.
* Lead remediation governance, risk-acceptance workflows, escalation pathways and exception management processes.
* Enable effective cross-team coordination across Cyber Functions such as Identity, Respond, Detect, Protect, Strategy, Delivery, Platform Engineering, Threat Intelligence, Architecture, Risk, Issues Engineers and Portfolio Cyber Leads. Reporting, Analytics & Metrics
* Deliver comprehensive operational dashboards and KPIs covering key areas of the attack surface such as scanning coverage, vulnerability spread, backlog trends, survival and churn rates, threat posture, exposure windows, exploitability indicators, and Critically Exposed Assets (CEA) pipeline performance.
* Ensure reporting is accurate, timely and aligned to leadership expectations, enabling data-driven decision-making and clear visibility of exposure and progress.
* Maintain structured analytics frameworks to measure remediation effectiveness, prioritisation accuracy and overall functional performance across all attack-surface domains.
* Partner with Operational Insights to provide insights and trend analysis that support continuous improvement, strategic planning and operational excellence across Cyber Operations.

**Relevant Services**

* Threat Exposure Management (TEM)
* Vulnerability Management (VM)
* Attack Surface Management (ASM)
* External Attack Surface Management (EASM)
* Enterprise Surface Discovery (ESD)

**Professional Background**

8–10+ years of progressive experience in enterprise cyber security with demonstrable in-depth technical expertise across Threat Exposure Management, Vulnerability Management, Defensive and Offensive Security, Application Security, Cloud Security, OT/ICS Security, Data and Identity Security, and AI/ML Security. Experience must span large-scale, heterogeneous environments with complex technology stacks. Certifications such as CISSP, CISM and GIAC (GMON, GICSP, GWEB, GCSA) are advantageous, but equivalent hands-on technical capability, advanced analytical proficiency, and a strong record of continuous learning and practical security training are essential.

**Leadership & Communication**

* Proven experience in directly managing a team of Threat Exposure and Vulnerability Management Analysts, including mentoring, developing and guiding security professionals within a collaborative, high-performing environment.
* Strong strategic and visionary capabilities, with the ability to co-develop and drive the function’s technical vision, strategy and roadmap in alignment with business objectives and the organisation’s threat appetite. Technical Expertise
* Deep knowledge of vulnerability management, threat exposure management, exploit development concepts, exposure validation, and remediation governance.
* Strong understanding of common security vulnerabilities, attack vectors, and security testing frameworks, such as OWASP, MITRE ATT&CK, CVE / CVSS, and NIST SP 800-53.
* Robust expertise across technical domains such as IT, OT, Cloud, network security, container environments, and identity-centric security. · Proven capability in AppSec, secure coding practices, CI/CD and IaC security, and DevSecOps tooling.
* Solid understanding of AI/ML architecture, AI security threats, LLM exposure risks, and secure integration patterns.
* Hands-on expertise with tooling in different landscapes: VM, ASM/EASM, AppSec, Cloud, OT, Data, Identity, AI. Stakeholder Engagement & Culture
* Serve as the advisor and central point of contact for all Threat Exposure and Vulnerability Management matters across the organisation within a given scope.
* Build strong relationships with industry partners, vendors, and the wider technology ecosystem to incorporate external expertise, benchmark performance, and stay ahead of emerging threats and vulnerability trends.
* Develop trusted relationships across Cyber, Portfolio teams, Engineering, and Business functions, anchored in transparency, accountability, and the organisation’s core values.
* Lead by example in strengthening collaboration, breaking down silos, and cultivating high-performing cross-functional networks.
* Promote a values-driven culture that embraces diversity, inclusion, and collective ownership of cyber risk.
* Champion staff education, awareness, and secure behaviours to embed a proactive, cyber-aware mindset across the organisation.
* Foster a responsive, delivery-focused culture that partners effectively with Technology and Business units to drive timely resolutions and value-led security outcomes.

title: Data Engineer
description:
**Job Requirements**  

At Quest Global, it’s not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place—to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster

We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day. Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. Our teams regularly invest time and dedicated effort into internal culture work, ensuring that all voices are heard.

**Job Summary**  
We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer with strong expertise in Python, SQL,  
ETL/ELT development, and cloud-based data platforms. The ideal candidate will be  
responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable data pipelines, data  
warehouses, and analytics-ready datasets that support reporting, business intelligence,  
and data-driven decision-making.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**ABOUT DYSRUPIT**

DysrupIT is a leading global-based cloud services company. We support clients across the globe in their adoption of the cloud and their transformation to as-a-Service business models. DysrupIT is dedicated to making a positive impact in the communities it serves.

**COMPANY CULTURE**

We are constantly looking for talented people to join our team. We offer a unique and extraordinary career experience to motivate and inspire talents like you to make a difference in our customers, clients, and the entire organization. At DysrupIT, you’ll join a team of dedicated and brilliant professionals who share the same goal of pursuing integrity and excellence. We are committed to promoting a culture where employees are valued and respected. We invest in our employees and make sure that they will have the right training to secure their growth and advancement towards their career aspirations.

**JOB SUMMARY**

We are seeking a Senior Data Engineer to own the ingestion, data model, and reconciliation layers of a financial billing and invoicing data platform built on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). This role is responsible for ensuring that every amount flowing through the platform is accurate, traceable, and fully reconciled.

  

The ideal candidate has 6+ years of data engineering experience, including financial or billing pipelines, with deep BigQuery expertise and strong Python and SQL skills. You will design robust, auditable data pipelines with built-in data quality controls, and work closely with engineers and business stakeholders to deliver trusted financial data.

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**

  

* Design, build, and maintain data ingestion pipelines for financial and billing data on GCP.
* Design and evolve the BigQuery data model, including nested ARRAY/STRUCT tables, partitioning, and clustering strategies.
* Implement reconciliation checks to ensure every amount balance end to end across source, staging, and output layers.
* Build file validation and quarantine processes to detect, isolate, and report invalid or incomplete source data.
* Design idempotent pipelines that can be safely rerun without duplicating or corrupting data.
* Implement append-only table patterns and use views as data checks to support auditability.
* Handle monetary values accurately using BigQuery NUMERIC types and appropriate rounding rules.
* Manage effective-dated reference data such as rates, mappings, and customer attributes.
* Establish and maintain data lineage so that every output can be traced back to its source.
* Write clean, typed, and well-tested Python code using pydantic and pytest.
* Write and optimize advanced SQL for transformation, reconciliation, and reporting.
* Collaborate with engineers, analysts, and finance stakeholders to translate business rules into reliable data logic.
* Mentor team members and contribute to data engineering standards and best practices.

  

**REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLSET**

  

* 6+ years of data engineering experience.
* Proven experience building financial or billing pipelines where every amount must reconcile.
* Strong Python skills, including pydantic, typed code, and pytest.
* Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, window functions, and performance tuning.
* In-depth Google BigQuery experience, including nested ARRAY/STRUCT tables, partitioning, and clustering.
* Experience handling money accurately using NUMERIC data types.
* Experience designing append-only tables and using views as data checks.
* Strong understanding of data quality practices, including reconciliation checks, file validation, and quarantine.
* Experience building idempotent, rerunnable pipelines.
* Experience implementing data lineage and managing effective-dated reference data.

  

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE**

  

* Invoicing domain experience, including credit notes, rebills, FX conversion, and month-end close.
* Experience working with finance or billing teams in a regulated or audited environment.
* Experience with other GCP services such as Cloud Storage, Cloud Run, or Firestore.

You will work closely with technical leads, architects, SRE, cybersecurity, QA, product, and other engineering teams to translate product and architecture requirements into secure, scalable, maintainable, and production-ready software.   + Air-gapped or restricted-connectivity environments

  + Large-scale telemetry or event-processing systems

  + Kubernetes-based edge deployments

* Develop software that can support deployment across Azure, GCP, Alibaba Cloud, and Cognition environments.

* Contribute to a common platform codebase while maintaining appropriate separation between common functionality and provider-specific implementations.

Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We are seeking a 12+ experienced Data Architect with strong expertise in Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, SQL Data Warehouse, and modern cloud data platforms to define and implement scalable, secure, high-performance data architectures.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for translating business and technical requirements into robust enterprise data architecture and solution designs, defining data platforms, integration patterns, data models, governance frameworks, and analytics solutions. The role will involve working closely with business stakeholders, data engineers, BI teams, application teams, and cloud/infrastructure teams to deliver scalable and cost-effective data solutions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Data Architecture & Solution Design**

**Microsoft Fabric & Databricks Architecture**

* Define enterprise architecture using Microsoft Fabric, including OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, Dataflows, Power BI, and related Fabric capabilities.

* Design Databricks solutions using Apache Spark, Structured Streaming, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and optimized data processing patterns.
* Define standards for partitioning, file sizes, schema evolution, incremental processing, data retention, and performance optimization.
* Guide teams in optimizing Databricks workloads for performance and cloud cost efficiency.

**Data Integration & ETL/ELT Architecture**

* Design models optimized for Power BI, analytics, reporting, and downstream applications.
* Define strategies for managing historical data, slowly changing dimensions, data retention, and archival.

**Data Governance, Security & Compliance**

* Define enterprise data governance and security architecture across the data platform.

* Define security patterns for row-level security, column-level security, masking, encryption, secrets management, and secure data access.
* Establish data ownership, data stewardship, metadata, lineage, and data quality standards.

**Performance, Scalability & Cost Optimization**

* Define architecture strategies to support high-volume and high-performance data workloads.

title: Senior Cyber Engineer - Security Logging & Data Platforms
description:
The Senior Cyber Engineer - Security Logging & Data Platforms is responsible for the hands-on engineering, operation and continuous improvement of the organisation's end-to-end security logging and telemetry capability.
  
The role works across the complete data pipeline, from collection at source through transport, processing, optimisation, routing and storage to SIEM and other authorised security consumers. The engineer ensures telemetry is reliable, scalable, secure, cost-efficient and usable for detection, investigation, threat hunting and operational decision-making.
  
This is primarily a technical engineering role. The postholder will also act as a key technical contributor to platform strategy, roadmap, lifecycle, capacity, cost and vendor discussions. The role does not carry formal people-management accountability, but the postholder will be expected to provide technical leadership, mentor colleagues and lead complex engineering activity when required.
  
The position supports a critical production capability and includes participation in the team's standby/on-call rota.

**Key responsibilities**
========================

**1. End-to-end security telemetry engineering**
------------------------------------------------

* Design, build, operate and troubleshoot security telemetry pipelines from source systems through collection and processing platforms to storage, SIEM and downstream consumers.

* Engineer appropriate collection patterns for cloud, SaaS, on-premises, network, endpoint and application sources using technologies such as APIs, syslog/CEF, JSON, Event Hubs, Windows Event Collection and agent-based collection.

* Own complex onboarding and integration work end to end, including requirements, design, build, testing, production deployment, validation, documentation and transition into support.

* Diagnose failures across distributed pipelines and coordinate recovery across internal teams, platform providers and technology vendors.

* Ensure pipeline designs meet security, availability, performance, scalability and supportability requirements.

**2. Logging platform engineering**
-----------------------------------

* Provide hands-on engineering across Stream, Edge and Search, including routes, pipelines, functions, packs, event breaking, worker groups, fleet management, lookups and search use cases.

* Maintain platform health through monitoring, patching, upgrades, vulnerability remediation, capacity management, configuration control and performance tuning.

* Develop reusable patterns and automation that make onboarding, routing and operational support faster, safer and more consistent.

* Optimise data volumes and processing to improve platform efficiency and manage ingestion, storage and licensing costs without compromising agreed security outcomes.

* Support the controlled extension of Cribl capabilities to suitable data and observability use cases beyond traditional SIEM ingestion.

**3. SIEM and security consumer enablement**
--------------------------------------------

* Engineer and support integrations into SIEM and other approved destinations, including long-term storage and search platforms.

* Monitor source, dataset and destination health and resolve issues affecting data availability, completeness, timeliness or usability.

* Work with SOC, RADAR, detection engineering, threat hunting and incident response stakeholders to translate security use cases into clear telemetry requirements.

* Validate that onboarded data supports intended detection, investigation and hunting outcomes before declaring delivery complete.

* Maintain clear accountability boundaries: enable high-quality security data and platform capability while partnering with the relevant teams that own detection content and operational response.

**4. Data quality and data-as-a-product**
-----------------------------------------

* Apply and improve standards for parsing, normalisation, schema alignment, enrichment, filtering, metadata, routing and data validation.

* Ensure data is not merely ingested, but is understandable, trustworthy and actionable for its intended consumers.

* Define quality checks and acceptance criteria for new and changed sources, including completeness, field quality, timestamp handling, duplication, latency and routing accuracy.

* Create and maintain source ownership, design decisions, dependencies, support models and known limitations.

* Use customer feedback, operational evidence and platform metrics to improve the quality and value of security data products.

**5. Operational engineering and service reliability**
------------------------------------------------------

* Operate the logging and SIEM pipeline as a critical production capability, including health monitoring, incident response, problem management, root-cause analysis and service restoration.

* Plan and execute production changes, upgrades and releases in line with change-control requirements and with minimal disruption to dependent services.

* Develop and maintain dashboards, alerts, runbooks, troubleshooting guides, recovery procedures and support documentation.

* Contribute to resilience, continuity and recovery planning, and test that critical operational procedures work in practice.

* Participate in the standby/on-call rota and support major incidents or high-priority operational activity when required.

* Maintain clear operational metrics covering platform health, ingestion failures, source coverage, backlog, change success, patching, capacity, data quality, cost and risk.

**6. Platform strategy, lifecycle and vendor contribution**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* Act as a key technical contributor to the strategy, roadmap and architectural evolution of the security logging, data pipeline and SIEM capability.

* Provide engineering input into lifecycle, capacity, licensing, cost forecasting, technical debt, supportability and investment decisions.

* Evaluate new features, integration patterns and technologies through structured technical assessment and proof of value.

* Work directly with strategic vendors and service partners to resolve technical issues, improve platform outcomes and influence product direction where appropriate.

* Identify operational or architectural risks early and provide clear options, recommendations and escalation paths to leadership.

**7. Technical leadership and capability uplift**
-------------------------------------------------

* Provide technical leadership without relying on formal line-management authority.

* Mentor engineers, review designs and implementations, and help colleagues build confidence in platform engineering, troubleshooting and operational practices.

* Lead complex engineering investigations and coordinate technical activity during high-impact changes or incidents.

* Promote shared ownership by establishing primary and secondary coverage for critical platform areas and reducing reliance on individual experts.

* Create reusable documentation, patterns and learning material so that successful solutions can be repeated consistently.

* Communicate progress, risks, dependencies and outcomes clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

title: Senior ETL Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
**Who are we and why should you join us?**

ConcertAI is building the future of precision medicine. We use advanced artificial intelligence and real-world data to transform how healthcare and life sciences generate evidence, make decisions, and improve patient outcomes—starting in oncology and rapidly expanding across therapeutic areas. Our teams partner with the world's leading pharmaceutical companies, providers, and research organizations to solve some of healthcare's most complex challenges.

At the core of our innovation is Cara, our next-generation AI platform that unlocks powerful insights from complex clinical, imaging, and molecular data. Combined with our Precision Suite—which unifies real-world data, advanced analytics, and scalable evidence generation—these solutions are transforming how clinical development, regulatory, and commercialization decisions are made.

ConcertAI brings together a portfolio of purpose-built solutions, including TeraRecon, an industry leader in advanced imaging and AI-driven visualization, and CancerLinQ, the ASCO-originated oncology platform advancing care quality and large-scale discovery.

Joining ConcertAI means working alongside bold thinkers, builders, and healthcare experts on innovative, high-impact products that directly improve patient lives. You'll be part of a fast-growing, mission-driven organization at the forefront of AI-enabled healthcare, with meaningful opportunities for growth and leadership.

#### **Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end testing of ETL and data pipelines across multiple processing stages.
* Review requirements, file layouts, data dictionaries, mappings, transformation rules, and data lineage.
* Develop test strategies, test cases, validation queries, and traceable QA evidence.
* Perform **source-to-target, file-to-table, table-to-table, and table-to-file reconciliation**.
* Validate record counts, field-level values, aggregates, calculations, transformations, filtering, enrichment, standardization, and default values.
* Test null handling, duplicates, data loss, referential integrity, matching, de-duplication, mastering, and survivorship rules.
* Validate inbound and outbound files for structure, headers, delimiters, data types, field lengths, required fields, encoding, and naming conventions.
* Create controlled test files and synthetic data to validate business and transformation rules.
* Design positive, negative, boundary, edge-case, regression, reload, and recovery scenarios.
* Investigate data-quality issues and identify root causes across source data, requirements, mappings, configurations, transformations, and downstream processing.
* Develop reusable SQL queries, scripts, reconciliation checks, and automated data-quality validations.
* Investigate production data issues and support post-deployment validation and regression testing.
* Collaborate with Data Engineering, Business Analysis, Product, Operations, and other technical teams to improve pipeline testability and diagnostics.
* Participate in client and data-vendor onboarding by reviewing specifications, sample files, mappings, and expected outputs.
* Identify requirements gaps, data-quality risks, ambiguities, and testability concerns during onboarding.
* Communicate testing status, defects, risks, blockers, and production-readiness findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Document and manage defects in Jira with supporting SQL, test evidence, and sample records.
* Lead complex ETL QA initiatives independently, defining testing strategy, scope, approach, and quality standards for critical data pipelines.
* Mentor and provide technical guidance to QA engineers on SQL validation, data reconciliation, test design, defect investigation, and ETL best practices.
* Drive continuous improvement of ETL QA processes by identifying automation opportunities, improving reusable validation frameworks, and strengthening data-quality and production-readiness checks.

#### **Qualifications and Skills**

title: AI Project Specialist
description:
Req ID:520173

  

At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, more than 80 000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

  

As part of Alstom’s global digital transformation, our Data Science & AI team plays a strategic role in accelerating innovation, operational excellence, and enterprise‑wide adoption of AI‑driven solutions.

**Your future role**

Take on a new challenge and apply your **Project Management** skills in the exciting cutting-edge field of Data Science and Artificial Intelligence. You’ll work alongside collaborative and forward-thinking teammates. You'll play a pivotal role in ensuring effective delivery of enterprise grade digital and AI‑enabled initiatives to support operational excellence at Alstom.

Day‑to‑day, you’ll collaborate with cross‑functional stakeholders to shape AI use cases end‑to‑end — from problem framing and feasibility, through requirements and backlog refinement, to planning and tracking project activities, managing timelines and milestones, and supporting coordination across business, PMO, and delivery teams. You’ll contribute to solution design discussions, assist in backlog refinement, and help ensure smooth execution and adoption of digital initiatives.

**We’ll look to you for:**

* Translating business needs into clear, functional and non‑functional specifications and high‑quality documentation
* Scoping AI use cases with stakeholders and defining success metrics/KPIs and acceptance criteria
* Supporting project planning, scheduling, milestone tracking and dependency management
* Managing end-to-end project from identifying Make vs Buy, RFP launching & processing and lead the project
* Organising discovery workshops and design thinking sessions to identify, prioritise and refine AI opportunities
* Conducting stakeholder analysis, gap and impact assessments, and maintaining traceability across requirements
* Collaborating with Data Scientists and Data Engineers, Architects, development teams and PMO to ensure alignment
* Ensure alignment on feasibility, requirements, dependencies and delivery constraints across teams
* Managing product backlogs (epics, features, user stories) and supporting Agile ceremonies in Jira/Azure DevOps/Confluence
* Preparing project artefacts (RAID logs, dashboards, status reports, documentation)
* Coordinating with cross‑functional teams to track deliverables and resolve issues. Driving UAT planning, test coordination, defect management, training and adoption activities
* Identifying and tracking risks across scope, timelines, resources, governance and compliance.
* Supporting change management activities: communication, training coordination, onboarding and post‑deployment follow‑up
* Demonstrating curiosity, resilience, and a continuous‑learning mindset to evaluate new tools while ensuring value delivery
* Exposure to agentic AI platforms like Copilot Studio, M365 Copilot, Dataiku and LibreChat to support development of AI prototypes/PoCs will be a plus

**All about you**

We value curiosity, ownership and a growth mindset. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:

* Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data/Analytics, or equivalent with technical exposure
* 5–10 years experience as a Project Manager, Business Analyst or similar role in enterprise‑scale initiatives
* Proven experience in requirements engineering (BRD/FRD, user stories, process modelling such as BPMN/UML, prioritization techniques, acceptance criteria)
* Experience planning and coordinating multi‑stakeholder projects, including RAID and project dashboards
* Proficiency with BA/PM tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, MS Project, Excel and PowerPoint
* Strong communication and facilitation skills to interact with business and technical teams and translate complex AI/technical topics for non‑technical audiences
* Good understanding of Agile and/or Waterfall project delivery frameworks
* Experience supporting UAT, change management and user training for digital solutions
* Familiarity with data analytics and reporting tools like Power BI and Qlik Sense
* Understanding of AI/ML concepts and lifecycle (use‑case framing, data pipelines, evaluation metrics, model limitations) is expected.
* **Good To have:**
  + Experience with agentic AI platforms (e.g., Copilot Studio, M365 Copilot, Dataiku, LibreChat) and Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate)
  + Technical foundations (good to have): basic SQL, understanding of APIs/integrations, data structures and data quality concepts;
  + Certifications (good to have): PMP, PRINCE2, CSM, CBAP, PMI‑PBA

**Things you’ll enjoy**

Join us on a transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:

* Collaborate with transverse teams and supportive colleagues across a global enterprise
* Contribute to innovative AI programmes and work with cutting‑edge platforms to deliver solutions for business needs across Alstom
* Utilise a dynamic, learning‑oriented environment that fosters adaptability and technical curiosity
* Shape and influence digital delivery, stakeholder engagement and governance, with clear progression paths in Project Management, Business Analysis, Digital Transformation and Data & AI careers

  

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

**Job Description:**

  

As a Software Quality Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality and reliability of our software products through comprehensive test planning, test execution, and defect management. You will work closely with developers and product teams to identify and address potential issues early in the software development lifecycle. You will be expected to write automated tests using Python and the Robot Framework, contribute to test processes, and manage end-to-end testing to ensure our software products deliver the best user experience.

* Test Planning & Strategy:
  + Develop comprehensive test plans and test strategies for software applications based on requirements and specifications.
  + Define test cases, test data, and create a clear roadmap for testing activities.

  + Write, maintain, and execute automated test scripts using Python and Robot Framework.
  + Design and develop reusable and scalable automated tests for both functional and non-functional requirements (e.g., performance, security).
  + Integrate automated tests with Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines.

  + Optimization settings
  + Data reconciliation functions
  + Reporting and scheduling workflows

  + Reporting systems

  + Integration testing
  + Performance testing

* Migration strategy documents

* Testing results
* Commissioning reports

title: Infrastructure Engineer - BA4
description:
Date live: 10/16/2026

Business Area: Customer Digital and Data

Area of Expertise: Technology

Contract: Permanent

Reference Code: JR-0000136174

  

**Role Overview**
-----------------

We are looking for an experienced infrastructure Engineer who can build and maintain infrastructure platforms and products that support applications and data systems, using hardware, software, networks, and cloud computing platforms as required with the aim of ensuring that the infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and secure. Ensure the reliability, availability, and scalability of the systems, platforms, and technology through the application of software engineering techniques, automation, and best practices in incident response.

  
  

You will provide L2/L3 support for infrastructure and application stack while driving automation, reliability (SRE), and release excellence across environments.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Build and deliver high-quality infrastructure solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
* Deep experience in infrastructure engineering activities, including IAC, automation, design governance and troubleshooting.
* Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations and actively contribute to the organization’s technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.
* Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions.
* To perform assigned activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in Skillset like Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins, Shell script, Datadog, python, API, docker, containers, ECR, EKS and GitLab.
* Build modern CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, security controls and release automation.
* Collaborate closely with Product Owner, Solution Architect, Security, Platform and QA teams to deliver integrated digital solutions.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise security, risk, governance and regulatory requirements.
* Support cross-platform initiatives through working knowledge of iOS development principles and mobile ecosystem standards.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence.
* Support recruitment, onboarding, and team growth initiatives.
* Strong advocate of clean, testable, and maintainable code.
  

  

**Key Technical Skills and Experience**
---------------------------------------

* Programming language python or Java
* Technical Skills Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins, Shell script, Datadog, docker, containers, GitLab, Snyk, Qualys, Jira, Confluence, Datadog, JUnit, Maven, Gradle, and NPM
* AWS cloud computing EC2, ECR, EKS, S3, Cloud Formation, networks
* Database design and SQL
* Operating System knowledge – Windows, Linux and awareness on AIX
* System design and architecture.
* Experience with OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, token exchange, policy systems, delegated administration, or identity data modelling
* Ability to use AI engineering tools to accelerate research, code understanding, prototyping, implementation, and documentation while applying sound engineering judgment
* Experience building production services, distributed systems, or shared platform capabilities
* Experience designing and implementing APIs, RESTful services, integration contracts, and data or domain models
* Experience turning requirements and ambiguous problems into designs, prototypes, and production-ready solutions
* Experience with authentication, authorization, and identity management
* Ability to communicate technical decisions clearly, collaborate across teams and time zones, and support other engineers through feedback and knowledge sharing
* Familiarity with MCP, agent skills, and other agent integration concepts
* Experience contributing to technical designs and proof of concept work
* Manage incidents, problems, and changes using ITIL-aligned processes and SLAs (e.g., ServiceNow/Jira).
* Plan and execute OS patching cycles; maintain compliance with security and audit requirements.
* Maintain comprehensive runbooks, knowledge base articles, and support documentation.
* Very good understanding and solid hands-on on cloud computing system preferably AWS.
* Strong understanding on containers and hands-on experience in EKS/Docker also ability to write and deploy Helm chart.
* Build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, Nexus) to improve release velocity and quality.
* Hands-on experience in Blue-Green deployments and good understanding of various other deployment strategy.

**Purpose of the role**

To build and maintain infrastructure platforms and products that support applications and data systems, using hardware, software, networks, and cloud computing platforms as required with the aim of ensuring that the infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and secure. Ensure the reliability, availability, and scalability of the systems, platforms, and technology through the application of software engineering techniques, automation, and best practices in incident response.

**Accountabilities**

* Build Engineering: Development, delivery, and maintenance of high-quality infrastructure solutions to fulfil business requirements ensuring measurable reliability, performance, availability, and ease of use. Including the identification of the appropriate technologies and solutions to meet business, optimisation, and resourcing requirements.
* Incident Management: Monitoring of IT infrastructure and system performance to measure, identify, address, and resolve any potential issues, vulnerabilities, or outages. Use of data to drive down mean time to resolution.
* Automation: Development and implementation of automated tasks and processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention, utilising software scripting/coding disciplines.
* Security: Implementation of a secure configuration and measures to protect infrastructure against cyber-attacks, vulnerabilities, and other security threats, including protection of hardware, software, and data from unauthorised access.
* Teamwork: Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, architects, and other engineers to define IT Infrastructure requirements, devise solutions, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives via a data driven approach.
* Learning: Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations, and actively contribute to the organization's technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.

**Analyst Expectations**

* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

### **Why join Stryker?**

Looking for a place that values your unique talents? Discover Stryker's award-winning culture.  
We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.

### **Job description**

We are excited to be named one of the World’s Best Workplaces by Fortune Magazine!
  
We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.

Vocera, now part of Stryker, is seeking an experienced Staff Engineer (**Full Stack Software Engineer)** to develop and maintain enterprise analytics capabilities for healthcare communications data. This role works across **Angular applications, Java services and REST APIs, relational databases, and data-processing workflows** supporting dashboards, reporting, and operational monitoring.  
  
**What You Will Do**

* **Design and develop** full-stack features for analytics dashboards, scheduled reports, data exports, and operational monitoring using Angular, Java, REST APIs, and relational databases.
* **Build and maintain** Angular user interfaces for data visualization, filtering, reporting, exports, and administrative workflows.
* **Develop** Java backend services and REST APIs that query analytics data and support dashboard and reporting requirements.
* **Design and optimize** relational database solutions using complex SQL, schema design, indexing, stored procedures, and query-performance tuning for large datasets.
* **Develop and maintain** data-processing workflows that transform healthcare communications data, including calls, messages, badge activity, and alarms, into structured analytics data.
* **Troubleshoot and resolve** issues across user interfaces, backend services, databases, and data pipelines, including production and on-premises deployments.
* **Apply** secure coding, automated testing, resilient error handling, performance optimization, and privacy requirements appropriate for enterprise healthcare software.
* **Own** features through design, development, code review, testing, deployment, documentation, and production support while collaborating with Engineering, Product, Quality, DevOps, and Program Management.

**What You Will Need**  
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in **Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline**.
* **Minimum 6 -9 years of software development experience**.
* Experience developing full-stack applications using **Angular and Java**.
* Experience with **relational databases**, including complex SQL, schema design, indexing, stored procedures, and query optimization, with MariaDB or MySQL experience.
* Experience building and consuming **REST APIs** and developing data-rich web applications.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)** or another cloud platform.
* Experience developing **analytics, reporting, ETL, batch-processing, or data warehouse solutions**, including dimensional or warehouse-style data models.
* Experience with one or more of the following: **MariaDB production environments, Scala, Play Framework, Apache Spark, AngularJS, enterprise reporting tools, LDAP, SAML, Prometheus, Grafana, CI/CD, or automated testing**.

Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.
