title: Infrastructure Engineer AVP
description:
Date live: 10/16/2026

Business Area: Customer Digital and Data

Area of Expertise: Technology

Contract: Permanent

Reference Code: JR-0000136175

  

**Role Overview**
-----------------

  
  

We are looking for an experienced AVP Infrastructure Engineer who can build and maintain infrastructure platforms and products that support applications and data systems, using hardware, software, networks, and cloud computing platforms as required with the aim of ensuring that the infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and secure. Ensure the reliability, availability, and scalability of the systems, platforms, and technology through the application of software engineering techniques, automation, and best practices in incident response.

  
  

You will provide L2/L3 support for infrastructure and application stack while driving automation, reliability (SRE), and release excellence across environments.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Lead the design, build and support of secure, scalable and high-performing applications.
* Hands-on in infrastructure engineering activities, including IAC, automation, design governance and troubleshooting.
* Define and implement standards, patterns and development best practices.
* Drive adoption of modern CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, security controls and release automation.
* Collaborate closely with Product Owner, Solution Architect, Security, Platform and QA teams to deliver integrated digital solutions.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise security, risk, governance and regulatory requirements.
* Provide technical leadership across various technologies like Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins, Shell script, Datadog, python, API, docker, containers, ECR, EKS and GitLab.
* Mentor and coach team on career development through feedback, technical assistance performance management and development planning.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence.
* Support recruitment, onboarding, and team growth initiatives.
* Champion DevSecOps practices, observability, reliability engineering and operational excellence across the mobile landscape.
* Promote knowledge sharing through code reviews, technical discussions, pairing sessions, and documentation.
* Balance technical excellence with delivery commitments and business outcomes.

**Software Engineering**
------------------------

* Experience working within large-scale, complex, or long-lived mobile codebases.
* Strong understanding of software architecture, maintainability, and modern engineering practices.
* Strong advocate of clean, testable, and maintainable code.
* Experience balancing technical quality, operational stability, performance, and delivery objectives.

**Leadership & Collaboration**
------------------------------

* Comfortable providing technical guidance, code reviews, and architectural direction.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills.

* Experience driving a culture of engineering excellence and continuous improvement.

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing capabilities.
* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
* Collaborative and inclusive leadership style.
* Customer-focused mindset with strong attention to quality.

**Key Technical Skills and Experience**
---------------------------------------

* Programming language python or Java
* Technical Skills Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins, Shell script, Datadog, docker, containers, GitLab, Snyk, Qualys, Jira, Confluence, Datadog, JUnit, Maven, Gradle, and NPM
* AWS cloud computing EC2, ECR, EKS, S3, Cloud Formation, networks
* Database design and SQL
* Operating System knowledge – Windows, Linux and awareness on AIX
* System design and architecture.
* Experience with OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, token exchange, policy systems, delegated administration, or identity data modelling
* Ability to use AI engineering tools to accelerate research, code understanding, prototyping, implementation, and documentation while applying sound engineering judgment
* Experience building production services, distributed systems, or shared platform capabilities
* Experience designing and implementing APIs, RESTful services, integration contracts, and data or domain models
* Experience turning requirements and ambiguous problems into designs, prototypes, and production-ready solutions
* Experience with authentication, authorization, and identity management
* Ability to communicate technical decisions clearly, collaborate across teams and time zones, and support other engineers through feedback and knowledge sharing
* Familiarity with MCP, agent skills, and other agent integration concepts
* Experience contributing to technical designs and proof of concept work
* Manage incidents, problems, and changes using ITIL-aligned processes and SLAs (e.g., ServiceNow/Jira).
* Plan and execute OS patching cycles; maintain compliance with security and audit requirements.
* Maintain comprehensive runbooks, knowledge base articles, and support documentation.
* Very good understanding and solid hands-on on cloud computing system preferably AWS.
* Strong understanding on containers and hands-on experience in EKS/Docker also ability to write and deploy Helm chart.
* Build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, Nexus) to improve release velocity and quality.
* Hands-on experience in Blue-Green deployments and good understanding of various other deployment strategy.

**Purpose of the role**

To build and maintain infrastructure platforms and products that support applications and data systems, using hardware, software, networks, and cloud computing platforms as required with the aim of ensuring that the infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and secure. Ensure the reliability, availability, and scalability of the systems, platforms, and technology through the application of software engineering techniques, automation, and best practices in incident response.

**Accountabilities**

* Build Engineering: Development, delivery, and maintenance of high-quality infrastructure solutions to fulfil business requirements ensuring measurable reliability, performance, availability, and ease of use. Including the identification of the appropriate technologies and solutions to meet business, optimisation, and resourcing requirements.
* Incident Management: Monitoring of IT infrastructure and system performance to measure, identify, address, and resolve any potential issues, vulnerabilities, or outages. Use of data to drive down mean time to resolution.
* Automation: Development and implementation of automated tasks and processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention, utilising software scripting/coding disciplines.
* Security: Implementation of a secure configuration and measures to protect infrastructure against cyber-attacks, vulnerabilities, and other security threats, including protection of hardware, software, and data from unauthorised access.
* Teamwork: Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, architects, and other engineers to define IT Infrastructure requirements, devise solutions, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives via a data driven approach.
* Learning: Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations, and actively contribute to the organization's technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Test Manager
description:
**Job Requirements**  

We are looking for an experienced Test Manager with Test Architecture responsibilities. The role combines approximately Test Management and overall project test ownership with technical leadership.

The role is the single point of accountability for planning, coordinating, driving, monitoring, evaluating, and reporting all testing required for the project across the complete product lifecycle. This includes testing performed by internal teams, development teams, distributed teams, suppliers, and external validation partners.

The role will establish and govern an effective overall test approach, including appropriate use of test architecture, testability, automation, infrastructure, tools, continuous integration, and LLM/GenAI-enabled testing practices. The successful candidate must demonstrate an AI-ﬁrst mindset and the ability to apply AI responsibly to increase testing efficiency, coverage, traceability, and decision quality.

Key Responsibilities

Test Management and Overall Project Test Ownership

Own the overall project test strategy, Master Test Plan, test scope, test levels, coverage goals, completion criteria, and all project test deliverables.

Ensure the completeness, consistency, traceability, execution, evaluation, and reporting of all testing deﬁned in the Master Test Plan.

Plan, coordinate, drive, and control all required testing across the product lifecycle, including software, integration, system, regression, and applicable functional and non-functional testing.

Plan and control test phases, resources, schedules, dependencies, environments,infrastructure, and regression activities.

Coordinate testing performed by internal teams, development teams, distributed teams, suppliers, and external validation partners.

Identify testing risks early; deﬁ ne mitigation actions; continuously track risks, dependencies, and issues; and escalate critical concerns.

Monitor test execution, coverage, defects, quality metrics, test effectiveness, and overall product or system quality.

Drive defect management and ensure appropriate resolution, retesting, impact assessment, and transparent quality evaluation.

Prepare the test evaluation summary and provide clear test status and quality reporting to project stakeholders and upper management.

Provide an evidence-based quality assessment and recommendation as an input to the project’s release decision.

Incorporate customer feedback, ﬁ eld issues, and post-market learnings into test planning, validation scope, regression coverage, and continuous improvement activities.

Support regulatory audits and submissions by ensuring test evidence, traceability, quality metrics, test summaries, and release-readiness assessments are complete, consistent, and audit-ready.

Continuously improve test planning, governance, methods, metrics, and lifecycle integration.

Test Architecture and Technical Test Leadership

Deﬁne and continuously improve the test architecture, test infrastructure, testability

requirements, tools, and testing methods in alignment with project and quality goals.

Deﬁne and govern an appropriate test automation strategy and roadmap, including frameworks, reusable assets, coverage goals, conﬁguration management, and CI/CD integration.

Evaluate and introduce suitable testing technologies, tools, frameworks, prototypes, and automation solutions.

Apply LLMs, GenAI, and other AI-based technologies where they add value to test planning, requirements analysis, test design, test-case generation, automation development, test-data preparation, defect and log analysis, regression selection, traceability, and reporting.

Establish suitable governance for AI-assisted testing, including review, traceability, quality control, and protection of project information.

Guide and coach test engineers, development teams, and architects on testability,

risk-based testing, automation, advanced testing topics, and responsible AI-assisted testing practices.

Measure and improve the effectiveness of the test strategy, test architecture, automation, and testing environment.

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, Engineering, Mathematics, or a comparable technical discipline.

At least three years of relevant experience in software or system testing or development across the product lifecycle, with demonstrated experience leading or managing testing activities in a complex project environment.

Proven experience as a Test Manager or Test Lead with overall responsibility for project testing; experience as a Test Architect or in a comparable technical test leadership role is an advantage.

Strong knowledge of test strategy, Master Test Planning, estimation, resource and schedule planning, risk-based testing, test design, regression testing, defect management, metrics, traceability, and quality assessment.

Good understanding of software/system architecture, requirements engineering, testability, change-impact analysis, test infrastructure, and conﬁguration management of test assets.

Proven ability to deﬁ ne and govern an appropriate test automation strategy, including frameworks and CI/CD-based continuous testing.

Strong analytical, decision-making, stakeholder-management, communication, coaching, and technical leadership skills.

Experience working with international, distributed, supplier, or outsourced testing

teams.

ISTQB Foundation Level certiﬁcation or equivalent testing knowledge and

experience.

ISTQB Advanced Level certiﬁcation.

Experience with test-process assessment and continuous improvement.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Job Description**

Role purpose
  
Lead a healthy, capable and outcome-owned engineering group that delivers X3 readiness while protecting quality, customer continuity, people development and sustainable delivery capacity.
  
X3 context
  
Sage X3 is the SaaS-readiness programme for X3: a progressive transformation from tightly coupled legacy runtime patterns towards portable, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. The programme protects customer behaviour, partner IP and rollback while it modernises journeys, APIs, components, data paths, business logic, delivery automation and migration economics.
  
The role contributes to outcome-owned squads. India is a scalable engineering and product delivery centre, connected to Europe and North America through deliberate overlap, shared standards, recorded decisions and continuous support of production outcomes.
  
Required technical and domain skills
  
- Experience leading software engineering teams delivering commercial, cloud or ERP products.
  
- Technical fluency across modern backend engineering, SQL/databases, APIs, legacy modernisation, SaaS delivery and automation.
  
- Hands-on experience with containerisation and Kubernetes.
  
- Ability to manage distributed teams, dependencies, hiring, performance, development and difficult conversations.
  
- Comfort with delivery metrics, quality gates, reliability, support economics and evidence-based governance.
  
- Strong English communication and the judgement to balance near-term delivery with long-term capability.
  
Modern platform skills for this role
  
- Use developer and operator feedback, platform adoption, delivery flow, reliability, support effort and cost to guide capacity and improvement. Be fluent in secure delivery, identity, telemetry, lifecycle and rollback decisions for the group; implementation depth and tool use remain with the relevant engineers.
  
Preferred skills
  
- Experience scaling India engineering capacity in a global product organisation.
  
- Hands-on exposure to L4G/4GL, Progress 4GL, Web/Syracuse, data migration or batch processing.
  
- Sage X3/Xtrem and enterprise application language experience.
  
- Cloud platform, migration programmes, partner ecosystems or regulated SaaS.
  
- Formal people leadership qualification or Agile coaching experience.
  
Experience and qualifications
  
Typically 10+ years in software delivery, including 3+ years managing or leading engineering teams. Degree or equivalent experience in engineering, computer science or a related field.
  
Professional English is required for global collaboration. Equivalent practical experience is valued alongside formal qualifications.
  
Expected outcomes / success measures
  
- Squads have named owners, realistic capacity, clear dependencies and a visible path to each evidence gate.
  
- Delivery predictability, quality, retention, engagement and technical capability improve over time.
  
- India delivery owns meaningful outcomes with effective global collaboration rather than serving as a hand-off function.
  
- Customer continuity, supportability and rollback remain protected while modernisation accelerates.
  
\*Measures should be agreed with the squad and reviewed through the X3 monthly scorecard and quarterly evidence gates. For this role’s owned scope, show how customer behaviour and partner investment are preserved, capabilities \*\*become portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable, and quality, reliability, supportability and rollback are proven. Include safe migration and improved cost or delivery economics where relevant.\*
  
Key stakeholders and collaboration model
  
Works with Product Managers, Architects, Principal Engineers, People teams, Programme Management, Security, Cloud Support/L3, Customer Services, partners and senior leadership across regions. Maintains practical Europe/North America overlap for decisions and escalation.
  
Sage behaviours / leadership expectations
  
Customer Focus, Action Orientation, Accountability, Trust, Developing Talent, Innovation and Collaboration. Creates clarity, gives context, removes blockers and holds a high bar with humanity.
  
Every colleague is expected to protect customer continuity, partner investment, security and the integrity of evidence. Leaders additionally create clarity, develop talent and make accountable decisions visible.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

Core accountabilities and decision ownership
  
- Own delivery capacity, staffing, prioritisation flow, quality, dependencies, risk and continuity for one or more multidisciplinary squads.
  
- Create the conditions for engineers, automation specialists, product and architecture partners to deliver measurable outcomes rather than activity.
  
- Hire, onboard, coach, develop and retain talent in India while building effective links with Europe, North America and APAC colleagues.
  
- Run transparent delivery and risk reviews; ensure quarterly evidence gates, monthly scorecards and scope guardrails are respected.
  
- Partner with Architects and Product Managers on sequencing, trade-offs, escalation, operational readiness and customer impact.
  
- Ensure incident learning, support knowledge transfer, security, inclusion and psychological safety are part of normal delivery.
  
Decision ownership:
  
People and capacity decisions, delivery sequencing within mandate, risk escalation, team operating model and readiness recommendations. Escalates material product, architecture, security, legal or commercial decisions with evidence.
  
Common capability baseline
  
All X3 roles are expected to build capability in the following areas. Depth and decision scope increase with level:
  
- Understand X3 customer workflows, metadata, customisation and architecture well enough to protect supported behaviour, partner investment and SaaS readiness in the decisions owned by the role.
  
- Treat the internal platform as a product: use developer and operator research, feedback and adoption evidence to reduce cognitive load; provide self-service APIs and golden paths where they solve a demonstrated need.
  
- Use cloud-native service boundaries, versioned API contracts and event integration where appropriate, preserving compatibility and clear ownership across X3 capabilities.
  
- Apply CI/CD and secure software-supply-chain controls, with identity, secrets and policy enforcement built into relevant delivery and runtime paths.
  
- Make services diagnosable with OpenTelemetry-compatible logs, metrics and traces; define role-appropriate SLOs, reliability and resilience evidence.
  
- Manage performance and cost deliberately, and engineer lifecycle, upgrade, deprecation and rollback paths as part of supported capability ownership.
  
- Use migration, reconciliation and compatibility evidence to preserve customer data and behaviour while moving towards portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities.
  
- Use AI-assisted engineering securely, with human review, privacy and IP protection, regression evidence and a recovery path; use deterministic methods when they are more appropriate.
  
- Depth follows role scope: engineers demonstrate hands-on lifecycle capability in their discipline; managers, product and programme leaders, and architects need decision-relevant fluency, not universal coding or every tool. Containerisation and Kubernetes are required for all engineering roles. Infrastructure as code, GitOps and a custom internal developer platform apply where the role owns those paths.

title: Senior Data Engineer (Databricks, MLOps, AWS)
description:
GoTymeX is building some of world's fastest growing digital banks and the data team plays a key role in driving the bank’s vision of creating a platform that stimulates economic participation and facilitates broader financial inclusion by implementing creative best in class data and analytic solutions to achieve success in providing quality services and products to our customers and optimising the business.

As a **Senior Data Engineer** you will contribute to the mission by creating solutions that will directly support informed decision-making and innovation by providing clean, protected, quality and auditable data from various sources into fit for purpose data products.

**In this role, you can expect to:**

* Design, develop, test, deploy and monitor data pipelines in Databricks on AWS from a wide variety of data sources.
* Design, develop, test, deploy and monitor scalable code with PySpark and SQL in Databricks.
* Identify opportunities to improve internal process through code optimisation and automation.
* Build data quality dashboards, lineage flows / and or monitoring tools to utilize the data pipeline, providing active monitoring and actionable insight into overall data quality and data governance.
* Assist in migrating data from legacy systems onto newly developed solutions.
* Follow and lead best practices on all data security, retention, and privacy policies.

  
**Requirements**  

* Bachelor’s degree.
* **3+ years’ experience of building ETL/ELT pipelines.**
* Proven competency in solution design, development, implementation, reporting and analysis.
* Proficiency in **Apache-Spark, Python and SQL languages**.
* Proficiency in working with **Text, Delta, Parquet, JSON, CSV, and XML data formats.**
* Working knowledge of Spark structured streaming.
* **AWS infrastructure experience, specifically working with S3.**
* **Solid understanding of git-based version control, DevOps, and CI/CD. Experience of working on Atlassian stack a plus.**
* **Knowledge of common web API frameworks and web services.**
* Strong teamwork, relationship, and client management skills, and the ability to influence peers and senior management to accomplish team goals.
* Willingness to embrace modern technology, best practice, and ways of work.

title: Software Development Engineer II
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

**Introduction to the team:**
-----------------------------

  

We’re the Insurance team at Expedia Group. We build services and customer experiences that help travelers find and manage trip-protection options across brands such as Expedia , Vrbo, and Hotels.com .

Our systems connect insurance suppliers and their products to multiple points in the travel journey, including checkout, post-purchase, and trip management. We focus on making these experiences reliable, clear, and easy to use.

  

**In this role, you will:**

* Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain high-quality software that delivers reliable, accessible, and intuitive customer experiences.
* Translate product requirements into scalable technical solutions using modern software development technologies and sound engineering practices.
* Contribute to low-level system design, API design, and data modeling to support maintainable, resilient, and secure applications.
* Own features or components through design, implementation, testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and operational support.
* Collaborate across engineering, product, design, and other technical teams to deliver outcomes across multiple problem spaces.
Safely integrate and operate AI/ML-enabled solutions that improve product and engineering outcomes, applying foundational AI/ML concepts to real-world products and workflows.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience.
* 2+ years of relevant professional experience in software development.
* Experience owning features or components within a service or application from design and implementation through testing, deployment, and support.
* Proficiency in software development, API integration, data modeling, version control, automated testing, debugging, and production support.
Familiarity with low-level system design and developing maintainable, reliable, secure, and operationally resilient software solutions, as well as AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real-world products.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience delivering software products at scale with a focus on performance, accessibility, usability, security, and operational excellence.
* Demonstrated ability to use data and production insights to make technical decisions, diagnose complex issues, and improve the reliability and maintainability of production applications.
* Experience contributing to architecture and design decisions across multiple services or technical domains while collaborating effectively with partner teams.
* Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools or applying AI/ML concepts to improve product capabilities, engineering workflows, or customer outcomes.
Experience safely integrating, monitoring, and operating AI/ML-enabled features within software applications, with attention to reliability, governance, and measurable impact.  

  

**Accommodation requests**

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job\_accommodation .

  

**About Expedia Group**

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

  

**Important notice**

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ .

  

**Equal Opportunity**

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

title: Software Development Engineer 5
description:
**Sr. Staff Data Platform Engineer**
------------------------------------

### **Position Summary**

As a Sr. Staff Data Platform Engineer, you will be the primary architect and visionary for the core data infrastructure that powers the entire enterprise. This is a "platform-as-a-product" role; your mission is to build the internal foundation—creating the high-performance engines, abstraction layers, and self-service frameworks that enable hundreds of other engineers to move faster.

You will operate at the intersection of Systems Programming and Data Engineering, solving "hard-tech" problems like automated schema evolution, multi-engine compute optimization, and global data discovery. As a top-level technical individual contributor, you will bridge the gap between long-term business strategy and deep-kernel technical execution, ensuring WEX’s data platform remains a competitive advantage.

Is this role for you?

* YES, if: You are a Backend/Software Engineer who loves solving "Big Data" problems, building APIs for data discovery, and optimizing distributed systems.
* NO, if: Your primary expertise is writing SQL queries, building Tableau dashboards, or managing ETL workflows without deep experience in Java or Python system architecture.

### **Responsibilities**

* Architectural Sovereignty: Define the 3-5 year technical roadmap for the Data Lakehouse. You aren't just using tools; you are deciding how storage, compute, and metadata layers (e.g., Apache Polaris, Unity Catalog or Datahub Catalog) interact at an elemental level.
* Platform-as-a-Product: Build internal SDKs, CLI tools, and automated orchestration frameworks. Your goal is to abstract away cloud complexity via Control Planes and Custom Operators, allowing Data Engineers to focus on business logic rather than infrastructure boilerplate.
* Internal R&D: Prototype and benchmark emerging technologies (e.g., specialized Spark extensions) to keep the platform at the bleeding edge of performance and cost-efficiency.
* Global Governance & Security: Architect "compliance-by-design" systems. Automate data lineage, PII masking, and fine-grained access control across petabyte-scale environments without sacrificing developer velocity.
* Engineering Excellence & Influence: Set the gold standard for code quality and system design across the company. You will lead Cross-Functional Architecture Reviews and serve as the final escalation point for the most complex system outages or performance bottlenecks.
* Organizational Mentorship: Beyond individual mentoring, you will foster an "Engineering Community," influencing the hiring bar and professional development paths for the entire data engineering organization.

### **Qualifications & Experience**

* Experience: 15+ years in software engineering and distributed systems, with at least 4 years in a principal or staff-level capacity leading platform-scale initiatives.

**Core Technical Competencies (Software Engineering Focus):**

* Strong Software Foundations: Strong fundamentals on software engineering, system architecture, and scalable production applications (Algorithms, Data Structures, and System Design).
* Experience in the Java/J2EE ecosystem (Spring Boot, Microservices) and python. We are looking for a developer who writes clean, testable, and high-performance code, not just scripts.
* Data as a Product: Experience building the platforms / framework engines and APIs that power data movement, rather than just building the ETL/ELT pipelines themselves.

**Data Lakehouse Mastery:**

* Deep internal knowledge of Apache Iceberg, Hudi, or Delta Lake (metadata management, manifest files, and compaction strategies).
* Experience contributing to or deeply customizing open-source data projects (e.g., Spark, dbt).

**Cloud & Infrastructure:**

* Extensive experience with cloud architecture and services, including AWS (S3, EMR, Kubernetes, Lambda) and Azure.
* Deep understanding of CI/CD automation, modern development tools, Git Actions, Terraform and frameworks.

**AI-Driven Development & Productivity:**

* AI Native Development: Experience leveraging AI Code Gen platforms into software development lifecycle (SDLC) to automate code generation, reviews, generate unit tests, and perform root-cause analysis of system failures.
* LLM-Ops for Platform: Ability to architect the infrastructure required to support AI Agent development by enabling vector database integration.

**Leadership & Vision:**

* Proven track record of "leading by influence"—driving adoption of new technologies across multiple autonomous teams.
* Ability to communicate complex architectural trade-offs (e.g., "Latency vs. Consistency" or "Build vs. Buy") to C-suite executives and junior engineers alike.

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science (Distributed Systems focus) preferred, or equivalent deep industry experience.

title: Technical Consulting Engineer
description:
Job Description
  
  
Who We Are
  
**The name ThousandEyes was born from two big ideas:** the power to see things not ordinarily possible and the ability to collect insights from a multitude of vantage points. As the world continues its digital transformation and relies more on cloud services and the Internet, the"network" which is now both public and private, has become a black box our customers cannot see or understand.
  
  
Our Internet and cloud intelligence platform delivers the only collectively powered real-time view of the Internet and private networks, cloud, and SaaS platforms, helping enterprises and service providers identify problems before they impact revenue, damage brand reputation, or halt employee productivity.
  
  
In August 2020, Cisco Systems completed the acquisition of ThousandEyes, which now forms the ThousandEyes Business Unit within the Cisco Networking Business Group and is the Network Assurance solution for Cisco across the Cisco Networking Cloud and Cisco Security Cloud. ThousandEyes is also a foundational component of Cisco’s growing Full-Stack Observability "FS") business.
  
  
About The Role
  
We're all familiar with the technology, but have you ever wondered how the Internet actually works? At ThousandEyes, we spend every day working to help customers understand the gotchas of Internet-based service delivery: how to identify problems, how to resolve, and how to avoid them in the future. Our Customer Engineering team is tasked with empowering our customers with ThousandEyes to ease their performance monitoring pains.
  
  
If you enjoy variety in job responsibilities, this is the job for you. A day may involve helping a customer identify network loss in an undersea cable, diagnose the cause of a route leak impacting significant portions of internet traffic, scripting an approach to monitoring a website's login flow, spinning up a lab environment to reproduce a strange set of behaviors seen in a customer's environment, saving a company hours of bridge time during a significant outage impacting their infrastructure by finding the smoking-gun in a network outage, or simply helping someone understand the way that our applications work. The job is highly variable and requires both the ability to make data-driven decisions, and draw conclusions based on incomplete information. We're looking for out-of-the-box thinkers who can complement and extend the already formidable talents of our Customer Engineering organization.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  

* Provide advanced technical expertise and leadership in solving complex, high-impact customer issues
* Lead the creation, refinement, and delivery of technical documentation, training materials, and knowledge content
* Partner closely with Engineering and Product teams to address systemic product issues and influence roadmap decisions
* Guide and mentor junior engineers, fostering technical growth and team development
* Submit and manage effective escalations, coach others on how to engage with Engineering and Product teams
* Utilize advanced software skills to configure, troubleshoot, or automate ThousandEyes product workflow
* Drive serviceability, usability, and product improvement efforts through customer feedback and technical insights
* Represent the support function in cross-functional meetings and customer engagements
* Contribute proactively to digital transformation by creating scripts, automation tools, and reusable assets
* Promote ThousandEyes' culture of collaboration, innovation, and technical excellence
* Timely interaction with customers and internal teams requesting support via online-chat, email and phone
* Active participation in 24x7 Support Coverage model

Qualifications
  

* A standout"customer firs" attitude
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* 4-7 + years of experience in a technical support, engineering, or related customer-facing role
* Specialist-level certifications (e.g. CCNP) or equivalent advance technical credentials preferred
* Experience with Cloud/SaaS software products is highly desirable
* Familiar with core networking principles - TCP/IP, DNS, web technologies, proxies and VoIP
* Working knowledge of virtualization technology - containers, virtualBox, VMware, HyperV, Xen
* Working knowledge in security - authentication, permissions, SSO
* Knowledge of one computer languages and programming (Java, Python, XML, RESTAPI) frameworks desirable
* Experience with the administration of Linux based Operations Systems a plus
* Experience in technical writing is a plus
* Ability to prioritize& complete tasks in a timely fashion
* Ability to communicate clearly and concisely to technical and non-technical users
* Proven troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
* Expert in one or more technical domains; broad knowledge across ThousandEyes and networking technologies

**Business Justification as to why this hire is required, is this a backfill or additional headcount:**

  

Additional senior engineering capacity is required to execute the architectural transition of the Synergy Bluetooth host stack from APSS to the Q6 low-power domain. The role will strengthen full-stack Bluetooth ownership, accelerate architecture and product problem solving, and enable scalable development across XR and Wearables programs.

**Job Overview - Dept Description and Job Duties:**

  

The Bluetooth Common IP team is seeking a highly analytical and hands-on Senior Engineer to design, develop, port, integrate, and sustain Bluetooth host software across APSS and Q6/LPI environments. The engineer will be a key contributor to the full-stack architecture in which Bluetooth host protocols, profiles, application services, and supporting platform interfaces progressively evolve to meet Days of Use (DOU) targets for our products in XR & Wearables.

  

This is an implementation-focused role for an exceptional developer who can work from Bluetooth specification and system architecture through detailed design, efficient C code, integration, debugging, and productization. The engineer is expected to use AI-assisted engineering responsibly to accelerate understanding, development, reviews, test creation, failure analysis, and documentation while independently validating all outputs.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Bluetooth stack development: Develop and maintain Bluetooth Classic, Bluetooth Low Energy, and LE Audio host protocols, profiles, services, and product-specific use cases.

* Platform adaptation: Port or redesign OS, memory, threading, timer, storage, security, IPC, transport, logging, and diagnostic dependencies for a resource-constrained low-power execution environment.

* Architecture and interfaces: Define clean, scalable module boundaries and APIs between the Bluetooth stack, controller transport, audio services, offload framework, OEM applications, Android/APSS services, and Q6 platform components.

* End-to-end ownership: Own features from requirements and feasibility through design, implementation, unit testing, integration, interoperability, performance optimization, issue resolution, and release support.

* Protocol analysis: Translate Bluetooth Core and profile specifications into robust implementations and use protocol-level reasoning to diagnose failures across host, controller, transport, peer device, and application layers.

* Performance and robustness: Optimize memory footprint, compute utilization, latency, concurrency, power behavior, and recovery paths for embedded and low-power targets.

* AI-assisted engineering: Use approved AI coding and analysis tools to accelerate code comprehension, solution exploration, test generation, log triage, documentation, and repetitive development tasks. Apply engineering judgment, security discipline, source review, and thorough validation before adoption.

* Collaboration and technical leadership: Partner with Bluetooth firmware, audio, systems, platform, application, test, product, and customer engineering teams. Drive design reviews, mentor engineers, identify risks early, and communicate decisions and trade-offs clearly.

  

Qualifications needed

* Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.

* 6+ years of embedded software development experience, with strong hands-on development in C/C++ for wireless connectivity or comparable embedded products.

* Strong working knowledge of Bluetooth architecture, host-controller interactions, and Bluetooth Classic/BLE protocols, with the ability to scale rapidly into unfamiliar protocols, profiles, specifications, and product use cases.

* Excellent C programming, data-structure, concurrency, memory-management, and defensive-programming skills.

* Strong analytical problem-solving ability, including decomposition of ambiguous system issues, hypothesis-driven debugging, trade-off evaluation, and root-cause isolation across software and hardware boundaries.

* Experience with IPC, multithreading, synchronization, transport interfaces, embedded storage, logging, and debugging of distributed or multi-processor systems.

* Ability to read specifications, architecture documents, code, traces, and logs and convert them into clear designs and reliable implementations.

* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including design documentation, technical presentations, and cross-functional reviews.

Minimum Qualifications:

* At least 3-6 years’ experience in embedded SW development using the C programming language for Wireless connectivity products

* Demonstrated ability to design, port, debug, and optimize complex software on Linux and/or RTOS environments.

* Experience porting a protocol stack to MCU, or RTOS-based low-power execution environments.

* Practical experience using enterprise-approved generative AI or coding assistants, with a strong understanding of validation, confidentiality, licensing, and secure-development expectations.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Hands-on experience with Bluetooth host stack.

* Understanding of Bluetooth controller transports and arbitration, including UART, SPI/I3C or comparable inter-processor/controller interfaces.

* Experience integrating Bluetooth audio and connectivity services, including A2DP, AVRCP, HFP, LE Audio, audio routing, and session control.

* Familiarity with Bluetooth SIG qualification, specification interpretation, interoperability events, and contribution to standards or technical working groups.

* Experience with Bluetooth sniffers, air traces, HCI snoop logs, protocol analyzers, embedded debuggers, crash dumps, and performance/power profiling.

* **Educational Requirements:**

Bachelor’s Degree in Electronics or Computer Science from an internationally recognized institution.

  

**Keywords:** C Programming, Bluetooth host Protocols, Bluetooth Profiles, LE Audio (LEA), BT, Sniffer, Air logs

**Minimum Qualifications:**

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 1+ year of experience with Database Management Software.

* 1+ year of experience with API.

* 1+ year of work experience with Git, Perforce, or Source Code Management System.

* Applies Software knowledge to assist and support the design, development, creation, modification, and validation of embedded and cloud edge software, applications, and/or specialized utility programs.

* Analyzes user needs and software requirements.

* Designs and implements small software features for products and systems.

* Participates in the design, coding for small features, unit testing, minor debugging fixes, and integration efforts to ensure projects are completed on schedule.

title: Cloud Platform Engineer
description:
**About Us:**

  

LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years. Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and transparency.

LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 70 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific.

  
  
  

**Role Description:**

  

This is a great opportunity for a hands-on DevOps Engineers or Infrastructure Cloud Engineers with experience in cloud platforms (GCP). You will be tasked with transforming business requirements into robust cloud infrastructure solutions which forms the underlying foundation for all distributed systems and applications of the LSE Group.

  

As a Cloud Platform Engineer specializing in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), you will support and enhance our cloud environment, ensuring scalability, high availability, security, and cost-efficiency. This role involves close collaboration with various teams to drive cloud adoption and implement GCP standard methodologies.

  

**Main Responsibilities:**

  

GCP Infrastructure Design and Implementation:

* Implement scalable, reliable, and secure infrastructure using GCP services such as Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL, Cloud Functions, VPC, and Interconnect.

* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform and YAML configuration files.

  
  

Security and Compliance

* Apply GCP security best practices including IAM, VPC Service Controls, Cloud KMS, and Organization Policies.

  
  

Automation and DevOps Integration

* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitLab pipelines.

* Automate deployments and infrastructure provisioning using Terraform and GitOps practices.

  

Networking and Hybrid Connectivity

* Manage VPC networks, subnets, firewall rules and policies, Cloud NAT, and Private Google Access.

* Implement networking features such as VPC Peering, Shared VPC, VPN, and Cloud Interconnect.

  
  

Agile Practices and Teamwork Tools

* Participate in Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives).

* Use Jira for task tracking and Confluence for documentation and teamwork.

  
  

Innovation and Continuous Improvement

* Stay current with GCP innovations and evaluate new services for potential adoption.

* Propose and implement improvements to enhance performance, security, and developer experience.

  
  

**Required Skills:**

  

Experience

* Minimum 3 to 5 years of hands-on experience with GCP services.

  
  

Technical Skills

* Good knowledge of GCP services: Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL, Cloud Functions, VPC, Cloud Interconnect, GKE, BigQuery, Cloud Run, Network Connectivity Center (NCC), Workload Identity Federation (WIF).

* Experience with Terraform and YAML for Infrastructure as Code.

* Networking knowledge: VPC design, VPN, Cloud NAT, Interconnect, Peering, firewall rules and policies.

* Familiarity with Docker and container orchestration (GKE).

* Experience with Python for various applications.

* Experience with Git, Jira, Confluence, and Agile methodologies.

  
  

Certifications

* Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer or other relevant GCP certifications.

  
  

Soft Skills

* Problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.

* Communication and collaboration abilities.

* Adaptability and eagerness to learn new technologies.

title: Senior AI Evals Engineer
description:
**About the Role**
------------------

The **Senior AI Evals Test Engineer** is a hands-on technical role responsible for defining, developing, and executing robust evaluation frameworks and test strategies for AI agents built using the **Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) or similar sort of agentic frameworks**. This role bridges AI development and reliable deployment — ensuring our agents are safe, ethical, effective, and meet high-quality performance standards. A significant focus of the role is on Responsible AI and Safety Evals, including **adversarial testing, red-teaming, bias detection, and toxicity measurement**. The engineer will **design scalable evaluation pipelines**, build synthetic test environments, and work closely with AI/ML Engineers, Researchers, and policy teams to ensure agents are production-ready and compliant with regulatory and ethical standards. The role is **70% Automation and 30% Manual Testing**, and sits within the **Applied AI: Test Engineering team** as a key technical authority.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Design and build agent evaluation frameworks** — create end-to-end infrastructure for evaluating LLM-based agents across correctness, latency, cost, safety, and task completion rate
* **Build synthetic testing environments and simulation strategies** to stress-test AI agents under diverse real-world conditions, with specific focus on agents built on Google ADK and related Google AI/ML services (e.g., Vertex AI, Gemini models)
* **Build golden datasets and test harnesses** — curate domain-specific evaluation sets for Rubrik's product verticals (data security, SaaS protection, cyber recovery, compliance)
* **Establish eval-as-a-service** — build and enhance centralized evaluation platform that any IT team members can self-serve to test their agents against standardized and custom benchmarks
* **Automate regression and drift detection** — implement CI/CD-integrated eval pipelines that catch regressions on every model or prompt change before production deployment

title: Compiler Performance Engineer
description:
**Falcon** is the optimizing just in time (JIT) compiler in Azul Platform Prime. It compiles hot Java bytecode into highly optimized machine code and delivers Java performance that standard JVMs do not reach. Falcon is built on LLVM.

We are looking for a **Compiler Performance Engineer** to make Falcon generate even faster code. This is not a compiler front end role and not a compiler built from scratch: the compiler exists, runs in production at large enterprises, and your job is to find where the generated code is slower than it should be and fix it in the optimizer and code generator.

You will join a distributed team of compiler experts and work on real workloads with direct, measurable impact on customer performance.

### **What You Will Do (aka Responsibilities)**

* Analyze performance of Java benchmarks and customer workloads, find gaps in generated code and trace them to their root cause in the compiler
* Implement and improve optimizations in Falcon's middle end and back end: inlining, loop optimizations, vectorization, redundancy elimination, speculative optimizations and their interaction with the runtime
* Improve code generation for x86\_64 and AArch64
* Write tests and benchmarks that prove the improvement and protect it from regressions
* Contribute changes upstream to LLVM where it makes sense

### **What You'll Bring (Experience, Skills)**

* 2+ years of professional experience in compilers, JIT compilers or low level performance engineering
* Strong C++ design and coding skills
* Solid understanding of compiler optimization theory: SSA, data flow analysis, loop transformations
* Ability to read assembly and reason about why one instruction sequence is faster than another

### **Very Nice to Have**

* Experience with LLVM IR and LLVM optimization passes, or with another optimizing compiler such as HotSpot C2, Graal, GCC or V8
* Experience with profilers such as perf, VTune or async profiler
* Knowledge of x86\_64 and/or AArch64 microarchitecture
* Experience with Java, Scala or Kotlin, or with JVM internals
* MSc or PhD in Computer Science with a compiler or performance focus

We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number.

**What to know:**

* Commvault does *not* conduct interviews by email or text.

* Commvault recruiters may contact prospective candidates through LinkedIn and other professional networking platforms regarding career opportunities. If you are unsure whether a recruiting communication is legitimate, review the profile to ensure they have a badge verifying them as a Commvault employee.

If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at wwrecruitingteam@commvault.com

  

**About Commvault**

Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) is the gold standard in cyber resilience. The company empowers customers to uncover, take action, and rapidly recover from cyberattacks – keeping data safe and businesses resilient. The company’s unique AI-powered platform combines best-in-class data protection, exceptional data security, advanced data intelligence, and lightning-fast recovery across any workload or cloud at the lowest TCO. For over 25 years, more than 100,000 organizations and a vast partner ecosystem have relied on Commvault to reduce risks, improve governance, and do more with data.

**Data Engineer**

**The Opportunity:**

The Data Engineer is a critical member of the Business Intelligence and Analytics organization, responsible for architecting, building, and scaling enterprise data platforms that power advanced analytics and decision-making. This role focuses on designing and operationalizing robust, cloud-native data pipelines and data stores, ensuring reliable, high-quality, and governed data is available across the enterprise.

The Data Engineer partners closely with analytics, data science, and business teams to transform raw data into trusted, consumable assets. By leveraging modern data technologies and best practices, this role drives data accessibility, performance optimization, and scalability while enforcing strong data governance and quality standards.

**What you’ll do…**

**Data Engineering & Pipeline Development**

* Design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable ELT/ETL pipelines across multiple data sources
* Develop data ingestion frameworks for batch and near real-time data processing
* Ensure data integrity through validation, monitoring, and error handling mechanisms

**Data Modeling & Architecture**

* Design and implement logical and physical data models for analytics and reporting

**Cloud Platform & Tools**

* Implement data quality checks, monitoring, and alerting for critical data assets
* Ensure alignment with enterprise data governance, metadata, and security standards
* Maintain data lineage and support auditability and compliance requirements
* Uphold data accuracy, consistency, and availability SLAs

  

**Analytics & BI Enablement**

* Deliver curated, modeled datasets to support BI tools such as Power BI
* Partner with analytics teams to enable dashboards, reporting, and self-service analytics
* Ensure data structures are optimized for performance and usability in reporting environments

  

**Performance Optimization**

* Tune SQL queries, data models, and pipelines for optimal performance
* Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across data systems
* Recommend improvements to data infrastructure and processing workflows

  

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Collaborate with business areas and BSA teams to align data requirements
* Translate business needs into scalable and maintainable data solutions
* Support project planning, requirements gathering, and solution design
* Identify opportunities for process improvement and data-driven innovation

**Engineering Best Practices**

* Follow best practices for version control, testing, and deployment of data pipelines
* Contribute to CI/CD processes for data engineering workflows
* Document data flows, models, and processes for maintainability and knowledge sharing
  

**AI / ML & Advanced Analytics Enablement**

* Awareness of emerging AI/GenAI capabilities and their data requirements
* Familiarity of integration patterns for Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar tool-based interfaces, enabling AI agents and copilots to interact with enterprise data
* Support integration of AI/ML solutions by enabling reliable data flows between enterprise data platforms and downstream applications
* Support data requirements for model explainability, lineage, and governance
* Exposure to tools such as Python (Pandas, NumPy), MLflow, or similar
* Experience working with large-scale datasets for predictive or AI-driven applications

* Master’s degree in a relevant discipline is a plus

* Databricks or Spark-related certifications
* Relevant certifications in data engineering, cloud platforms, or analytics

title: Data Engineer
description:
Meet the Team
  
Cisco's Centralized Analytics Team builds and operates the data platform and analytics foundations that Cisco's pricing, reporting, and AI initiatives run on. The team owns the path from enterprise data warehouse through to governed, self-service analytics — delivering trustworthy data products, semantic models, and serving layers to partner organizations including the Pricing Team. You will work at the intersection of data engineering, platform engineering, and data governance, enabling analytics and AI teams to build on data they can trace and trust.
  
  
Your Impact
  

* Design, build, and operate batch and streaming data pipelines on Snowflake and/or Databricks
* Turn reference architectures and data contracts from the Principal AI Data Architect into robust, production-grade implementations
* Deliver reliable, observable, cloud-native ETL/ELT for both structured and unstructured data
* Modernize legacy jobs with measurable gains in latency, reliability, and cost

Implement the semantic models, dimensional schemas, and entity-centric structures that make data trustworthy and reusable
  

* Maintain the metadata, catalog, and lineage that let any downstream consumer trace an output back to its source
* Build the low-latency APIs, materialized views, and serving layers that power dashboards, reporting, and ML/AI applications
* Embed data quality checks, RBAC/ABAC, masking, and encryption directly into your pipelines
* Instrument workflows with logs and metrics so failures are caught before consumers see them
* Automate testing, deployment, and rollback through CI/CD — a pipeline isn't"don" until it's tested, observable, and in an automated deployment workflow

**Minimum Qualifications:**  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field

5–8 years of hands-on data engineering or software engineering experience building production data platforms
  

* Cloud Data Platforms – Proven experience building and operating cloud-native pipelines on Databricks (PySpark, Delta Lake) and/or Snowflake, with modern orchestration tooling (Airflow, dbt, Dagster, or equivalent).
* Batch& Streaming Processing – Strong production experience with both batch and streaming data processing (Kafka, Spark Structured Streaming, Kinesis, or equivalent).
* Python, SQL& Data Modeling – Strong Python and SQL, with data modeling depth across dimensional, star/snowflake, and entity-centric patterns, and a track record of performance and cost tuning.
* Data Quality& Observability – Practical experience implementing data quality checks, monitoring, and observability for production pipelines.
* Cloud, CI/CD& Containers – Hands-on with AWS and/or Azure services (S3, Glue, Lambda, ADLS, Data Factory, or equivalents), plus CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps) and containers (Docker/Kubernetes).
* Data Governance – Working knowledge of access control, masking, encryption, lineage, and auditability.

**Nice to have qualifications:**  

* Infrastructure as Code – Practical exposure to Terraform or equivalent IaC tooling for provisioning and managing data infrastructure.
* Search& Vector Platforms – Experience with OpenSearch, pgvector, or similar search and retrieval platforms.
* Knowledge Graphs – Familiarity with graph data stores such as Neo4j and entity-relationship modeling at scale.
* ML& AI Pipeline Exposure – Exposure to embedding pipelines, vector search, MLflow, or ML/LLMOps tooling, and general familiarity with how data pipelines feed model training and inference. Welcome but not required — we'll teach you that side.
* Cloud Cost Awareness – Interest in right-sizing cloud resources and improving the efficiency of automation and data pipelines.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

* Make decisions on technical changes and enhancements
* Consult with engineering team on change design requiring solid understanding of technical process controls or standards that influence and drive new initiatives
* Collaborate and consult with technical peers, colleagues, and mid to more experienced level managers to resolve systems support issues and achieve goals

**Required Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of Systems Engineering, Technology Architecture experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

**Desired Qualification:**

* Experience in **Software Engineering, SRE, DevOps, or Platform Engineering**.
* Strong proficiency in **Python for automation and tooling**.
* Hands‑on experience with **Grafana, Prometheus, and Splunk** in production environments.
* Solid understanding of **SLIs, SLOs, dashboards, alerting, and observability best practices**.
* Experience applying **AI/ML concepts** to monitoring, alerting, or operational analytics.
* Strong knowledge of **Linux, networking, and distributed systems**.
* Experience with **Cloud platforms and Kubernetes/OpenShift**.
* Proven experience leading incidents, RCAs, and reliability initiatives
* Experience building **custom Prometheus exporters** or advanced Grafana dashboards.
* Strong Splunk expertise (search, dashboards, alerts, log pipelines).
* Experience operationalizing ML models for observability (AIOps).
* Familiarity with **CI/CD, Terraform, Ansible**, and enterprise automation platforms.
* Experience supporting large‑scale, regulated, or globally distributed systems.
* Improved reliability and performance against defined SLOs.
* Reduced alert noise and faster detection and recovery of incidents.
* Increased automation and self‑healing adoption using Python and observability signals.
* Strong observability maturity across platforms and applications.
* Improved MTTD and MTTR through effective use of Grafana, Prometheus, and Splunk.

**Job Expectation:**

**Reliability & Availability Engineering**

* Own and improve **availability, performance, scalability, and resilience** of production systems.
* Define, monitor, and manage **SLIs/SLOs and error budgets** to guide reliability investments.
* Lead capacity planning, performance testing, failover readiness, and disaster‑recovery design.

**Observability & Monitoring (Grafana / Prometheus / Splunk)**

* Design and operate a **comprehensive observability stack** using:
  + **Prometheus** for metrics collection and alerting
  + **Grafana** for dashboards, visualization, and SLO tracking
  + **Splunk** for log aggregation, troubleshooting, and incident forensics
* Build and maintain **golden dashboards** and actionable alerts aligned to business impact.
* Reduce alert fatigue through signal‑based monitoring and correlation of metrics, logs, and traces.
* Partner with application teams to define **instrumentation standards** for metrics and logging.
* Use observability data to improve **MTTD, MTTR, and reliability outcomes**.

**Automation & Python Engineering**

* Develop **Python‑based automation** for monitoring, alert remediation, deployments, scaling, and recovery.
* Build self‑healing workflows integrated with Prometheus alerts and Splunk signals.
* Create reusable automation frameworks and internal SRE tooling.
* Embed automation into CI/CD pipelines to improve deployment safety and reliability.

**AI/ML‑Driven Reliability (AIOps)**

* Apply **AI/ML techniques** to observability and operations use cases, including:
  + Anomaly detection on Prometheus metrics
  + Log pattern analysis and correlation in Splunk
  + Predictive capacity and trend forecasting
  + Noise reduction and intelligent alerting
* Partner with data and platform teams to operationalize ML models in production.
* Evaluate and integrate AIOps capabilities into the observability ecosystem.

**Incident Management & RCA**

* Serve as **incident commander and senior escalation point** for P1/P2 incidents.
* Lead **blameless post‑incident reviews (PIRs)** backed by Grafana metrics and Splunk evidence.
* Drive corrective and preventive actions to completion.

**Platform & Application Partnership**

* Collaborate with platform, application, cloud, and SRE teams to embed reliability and observability by design.
* Influence architectural decisions to ensure systems are **observable, scalable, and operable**.
* Provide SRE guidance during major releases, migrations, and modernization initiatives.

**Security, Risk & Compliance**

* Ensure observability and automation comply with enterprise security and audit requirements.
* Support resilience validation, failover drills, and business continuity testing.

**Technical Leadership**

title: Identity & Access Management Engineer
description:
**About Marvell**

Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.

**Your Team, Your Impact**

Marvell is seeking a Senior level Identity & Access Management (IAM) Engineer with deep SailPoint Identity Security Cloud expertise to own and drive the technical direction of IAM across the enterprise.

**What You Can Expect**

* Drive the implementation of IAM technical architecture, with SailPoint Identity Security Cloud as the core governance platform, creating reference architectures aligned with security posture, and operational efficiency.
* Drive the integration of AI assisted IAM capabilities to improve decision quality, reduce manual effort, risk and champion use cases such as:
  + Intelligent access recommendations
  + Role and entitlement optimization
  + Risk based certification prioritization
  + Identity anomaly and outlier detection
* Make high impact technical decisions in areas of ambiguity, balancing risk, and scale.
* Lead the design and evolution of SailPoint ISC implementations, including identity lifecycle automation, access governance, role models, certifications, and integrations.
* Set engineering standards for rules, transforms, workflows, REST/SCIM integrations, and connector patterns.
* Drive reliability and scale of JML processes, ensuring strong controls, observability, and operational resilience.
* Architect and mature RBAC and entitlement-based governance models, including SoD and policy-driven access controls.
* Partner with Security teams to ensure IAM capabilities support audit readiness and compliance outcomes without introducing friction.
* Evaluate emerging vendor capabilities and influence platform adoption decisions with a long-term, architectural mindset.
* Serve as a trusted technical partner to application teams, infrastructure, security leadership, and audit stakeholders.
* Influence IAM adoption patterns across engineering teams without direct authority.

**What We're Looking For**

The ideal candidate will focus on defining architecture and influencing cross functional teams. The individual will serve as an IAM subject matter expert, responsible for evolving Marvell’s IAM capabilities toward a scalable, intelligent, and automation first identity platform, including the thoughtful adoption of AI driven IAM capabilities.

**Technical Competencies**

* Expert level hands-on experience with SailPoint Identity Security Cloud, including architecture, rules, workflows, transforms, roles, and certifications.
* Deep understanding of enterprise identity lifecycle management and HR driven provisioning.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, including authentication, Conditional Access, and identity governance integration points.
* Solid foundation in Active Directory architecture, group strategy, and directory security.
* Strong grasp of IGA concepts (RBAC, SoD, least privilege) and their real-world tradeoffs.
* Automation and scripting experience (PowerShell, APIs, or equivalent).
* Knowledge of Zero Trust and IAM security best practices.
* Experience with privileged access workflows preferred.

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years of progressive IAM experience, with demonstrated ownership of complex SailPoint environments.
* Proven experience operating at a senior level, influencing architecture and outcomes beyond a single team.
* SailPoint or IAM certification preferred.
* Strong ability to communicate technical decisions and tradeoffs across engineering and senior leadership audiences.

This role is eligible to participate in Marvell's bonus and equity plans, including a new hire equity grant and annual equity refreshers, ensuring you are rewarded for your contributions and remain invested in the company's long-term success.

**Additional Compensation and Benefit Elements**

With competitive compensation and great benefits, you will enjoy our workstyle within an environment of shared collaboration, transparency, and inclusivity. We’re dedicated to giving our people the tools and resources they need to succeed in doing work that matters, and to grow and develop with us. For additional information on what it’s like to work at Marvell, visit our Careers page.

Global Manufacturing Engineering at GMTCI is a bridge between Global Manufacturing Plants & Global Product Engineering in getting the Product & Process Right. GMTCI’s strategy is to “Execute Design / Simulation / Virtual / Engineering Workshare for the Globe + Enable Factory for the Future”

This position of Manufacturing Data Analytics Engineer is a Mfg 4.0 initiative in ME Vehicle Systems Automation Group which is primarily responsible for applying Data Analytics techniques on GM manufacturing processes in GM manufacturing plants across the globe to solve complex manufacturing business problems with big data. In this position, the engineer supports critical business operations and decision making through creation domain data exploration, data processing pipeline, and business intelligence reports.

This is primarily a non-travel job. Business travel will be necessary on special requirements and will be for a short duration. Depending on the need, there will be an International Short-Term assignment for 6 months in the first year for training & development.

**What You’ll Do**

* Design, develop, and maintain full-stack manufacturing intelligence applications using modern frontend, backend, and database technologies
* Build intuitive React/TypeScript user experiences for manufacturing dashboards, workflow tools, operational insights, and engineering applications

* Deploy and operate applications across enterprise, cloud, and edge environments using Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD automation, and production monitoring

Document architecture, APIs, deployment procedures, operating standards, and support processes while contributing to a culture of continuous improvement.
